segments.src: ## Know Which Calendar Applies to You
segments.tr: ## 본인에게 해당하는 일정 파악하기

segments.src: Start by identifying which system you belong to, because the dates differ.
segments.tr: 날짜가 다르므로 자신이 속한 시스템을 파악하는 것부터 시작하세요.

segments.src: - **Medicare (Oct. 15 – Dec. 7):** During this window, people already in Medicare can switch between Original Medicare and a Medicare Advantage plan, change Advantage plans, or join, switch or drop a Part D prescription drug plan. Changes generally take effect Jan. 1.
segments.tr: - **Medicare (Oct. 15 – Dec. 7):** 이 기간 동안 이미 메디케어에 가입된 사람은 오리지널 메디케어와 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜 간에 전환하거나, 어드밴티지 플랜을 변경하거나, 파트 D 처방약 플랜에 가입, 전환 또는 탈퇴할 수 있습니다. 변경 사항은 일반적으로 1월 1일에 발효됩니다.

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (Jan. 1 – March 31):** People already in a Medicare Advantage plan can make one change during this period, such as switching to another Advantage plan or returning to Original Medicare. It is not a second chance for everyone, so check whether it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (Jan. 1 – March 31):** 메디케어 어드밴티지 플랜에 이미 가입된 사람은 이 기간 동안 다른 어드밴티지 플랜으로 전환하거나 오리지널 메디케어로 돌아가는 것과 같은 변경을 한 번 할 수 있습니다. 모든 사람에게 두 번째 기회가 주어지는 것은 아니므로 자신에게 적용되는지 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace (varies by state):** On HealthCare.gov, the standard pattern has been to enroll by Dec. 15 for coverage starting Jan. 1, with open enrollment continuing into mid-January for coverage that starts later. Some state-run marketplaces set their own dates, and a few extend them. Check your state's exchange for its exact schedule.
segments.tr: - **ACA marketplace (varies by state):** HealthCare.gov에서는 표준 패턴이 1월 1일에 시작되는 보장을 위해 12월 15일까지 가입하는 것이며, 그 이후에 시작되는 보장을 위해 1월 중순까지 공개 가입이 계속됩니다. 일부 주 운영 마켓플레이스는 자체 날짜를 설정하며 일부는 연장합니다. 정확한 일정은 해당 주의 거래소를 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Employer plans:** If you get coverage at work, your company sets its own enrollment window, often in the fall. This guide focuses on Medicare and marketplace plans.
segments.tr: - **Employer plans:** 직장에서 보험에 가입하는 경우, 회사는 보통 가을에 자체 가입 기간을 설정합니다. 이 가이드는 메디케어 및 마켓플레이스 플랜에 중점을 둡니다.

segments.src: If you are turning 65 or are newly eligible, your Initial Enrollment Period works differently from the annual window.
segments.tr: 65세가 되거나 새로 자격을 갖추게 되는 경우, 최초 가입 기간은 연례 가입 기간과 다르게 작동합니다.

segments.src: Missing it can lead to late-enrollment penalties for some parts of Medicare, so look up your personal dates.
segments.tr: 이를 놓치면 메디케어의 일부 부문에 대해 늦은 가입 벌금이 부과될 수 있으므로 개인 날짜를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## Question 1: What Will This Plan Really Cost Me?
segments.tr: ## Question 1: What Will This Plan Really Cost Me?

segments.src: The monthly premium is the number people notice first, but it is only one piece of the cost.
segments.tr: 월 보험료는 사람들이 가장 먼저 주목하는 수치이지만, 이는 비용의 일부분일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: - **Premium:** The fixed monthly amount. For marketplace plans, this is the figure *after* any premium tax credit. Enter accurate income and household information on the application, since the credit depends on your expected income for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Premium:** 고정된 월 금액. 마켓플레이스 플랜의 경우, 이는 프리미엄 세액 공제 *이후*의 수치입니다. 공제액은 다가오는 해의 예상 소득에 따라 달라지므로 지원서에 정확한 소득 및 가구 정보를 입력하세요.

segments.src: - **Deductible:** What you pay before the plan starts sharing costs for many services.
segments.tr: - **Deductible:** 플랜이 많은 서비스에 대한 비용 분담을 시작하기 전에 지불하는 금액입니다.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance:** Flat fees or percentages you pay for visits, tests, procedures and prescriptions.
segments.tr: - **Copays and coinsurance:** 진료, 검사, 시술 및 처방약에 대해 지불하는 고정 수수료 또는 비율입니다.

segments.src: - **Out-of-pocket maximum:** The most you could pay in a year for covered, in-network care. After that, the plan pays covered costs.
segments.tr: - **Out-of-pocket maximum:** 보장되는 네트워크 내 치료에 대해 1년 동안 지불할 수 있는 최대 금액입니다. 그 이후에는 플랜에서 보장 비용을 지불합니다.

segments.src: A plan with a low premium may carry a high deductible.
segments.tr: 보험료가 낮은 플랜은 자기부담금이 높을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A plan with a higher premium may cost less overall if you expect regular care.
segments.tr: 보험료가 높은 플랜은 정기적인 치료가 예상되는 경우 전체적으로 비용이 더 적게 들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A useful exercise is to estimate your likely year: how many doctor visits, specialist appointments, prescriptions and possible procedures you expect, and then add up what each plan would charge.
segments.tr: 유용한 연습은 예상되는 연간 진료 횟수, 전문의 진료 예약, 처방약 및 가능한 시술 등 예상되는 한 해를 추정하고 각 플랜이 청구할 금액을 합산하는 것입니다.

segments.src: ### A Note on Marketplace Subsidies
segments.tr: ### A Note on Marketplace Subsidies

segments.src: The size of premium tax credits is set by federal law and has changed in recent years.
segments.tr: 보험료 세액 공제 규모는 연방 법률에 의해 설정되며 최근 몇 년 동안 변경되었습니다.

segments.src: Do not assume last year's price will repeat.
segments.tr: 작년 가격이 반복될 것이라고 가정하지 마십시오.

segments.src: Compare your actual 2027 quote, using the official marketplace's window-shopping tools or the Plan Finder, rather than relying on past experience.
segments.tr: 과거 경험에 의존하기보다는 공식 마켓플레이스의 윈도우 쇼핑 도구 또는 플랜 파인더를 사용하여 실제 2027년 견적을 비교하세요.

segments.src: Households that qualify for cost-sharing reductions should look closely at Silver-level plans, which can lower deductibles and copays for eligible enrollees.
segments.tr: 본인부담금 감면 자격이 있는 가구는 자격이 있는 가입자의 자기부담금과 본인부담금을 낮출 수 있는 실버 등급 플랜을 면밀히 살펴봐야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Question 2: Are My Doctors and Hospitals In the Network?
segments.tr: ## Question 2: Are My Doctors and Hospitals In the Network?

segments.src: Networks are one of the most common reasons people regret a plan choice.
segments.tr: 네트워크는 사람들이 플랜 선택을 후회하는 가장 흔한 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: - **Look up each doctor, specialist and hospital you use** in the plan's own provider directory, and confirm by phone with the office. Directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **Look up each doctor, specialist and hospital you use** in the plan's own provider directory, and confirm by phone with the office. Directories can be out of date.

segments.src: - **Understand the plan type.** HMO plans usually require you to use in-network providers and may require referrals. PPO plans generally offer more flexibility at higher cost. EPO plans typically do not cover out-of-network care except in emergencies.

Medicare Advantage plans use networks and often include extras, but they may restrict you to a local area and may require prior authorization for some services.

segments.src: ## Question 3: Does It Cover My Prescription Drugs?
segments.tr: ## Question 3: Does It Cover My Prescription Drugs?

segments.src: Drug coverage can change from year to year, even when you stay with the same plan.
segments.tr: 약물 보장은 동일한 플랜을 유지하더라도 해마다 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Check the formulary** (the plan's list of covered drugs) for every medication you take, including the dose and form.
segments.tr: - **Check the formulary** (the plan's list of covered drugs) for every medication you take, including the dose and form.

segments.src: - **Look at the tier** each drug falls into, since higher tiers cost more.
segments.tr: - **Look at the tier** each drug falls into, since higher tiers cost more.

segments.src: - **Ask about restrictions** such as prior authorization, step therapy (trying a cheaper drug first) and quantity limits.
segments.tr: - **Ask about restrictions** such as prior authorization, step therapy (trying a cheaper drug first) and quantity limits.

segments.src: - **Confirm your pharmacy.** Some plans offer lower prices at preferred pharmacies.
segments.tr: - **Confirm your pharmacy.** Some plans offer lower prices at preferred pharmacies.

segments.src: - **Read your Annual Notice of Change.** Medicare plans send this document in the fall. It explains changes to costs, coverage and networks for next year, and it is easy to overlook.

segments.src: For Medicare Part D, an annual out-of-pocket cap on covered drug spending now exists, thanks to changes made by the Inflation Reduction Act.
segments.tr: 메디케어 파트 D의 경우, 인플레이션 감소법(Inflation Reduction Act)의 변경 사항 덕분에 이제 보장되는 약물 지출에 대한 연간 본인부담금 상한선이 존재합니다.

segments.src: The cap was $2,000 in 2025 and is adjusted for inflation in later years.
segments.tr: 상한선은 2025년에 2,000달러였으며 향후 연도에는 인플레이션에 따라 조정됩니다.

segments.src: Check the Medicare Plan Finder for the exact 2027 figure.
segments.tr: 정확한 2027년 수치는 메디케어 플랜 파인더를 확인하세요.

segments.src: Many plans also offer the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which lets you spread out-of-pocket drug costs across the year in monthly installments instead of paying all at once.
segments.tr: 많은 플랜은 또한 한 번에 전액을 지불하는 대신 일년 내내 매월 할부로 본인 부담 약값 비용을 분산할 수 있는 메디케어 처방약 지불 계획을 제공합니다.

segments.src: Spreading the cost does not lower the total.
segments.tr: 비용을 분산한다고 해서 총액이 낮아지는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Question 4: What Is the Worst-Case Scenario?
segments.tr: ## Question 4: What Is the Worst-Case Scenario?

segments.src: Out-of-pocket caps are what protect you from a very expensive illness or accident.
segments.tr: 본인부담금 상한선은 매우 비싼 질병이나 사고로부터 사용자를 보호하는 장치입니다.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace plans** have a federal annual limit on out-of-pocket spending for in-network, covered essential health benefits. The limit is adjusted each year and is substantial for an individual, so look up the figure for the plan year you are choosing.

segments.src: If you are weighing Original Medicare with Medigap against Medicare Advantage, think about predictability versus flexibility.
segments.tr: 메디가프와 오리지널 메디케어를 메디케어 어드밴티지와 비교할 때, 예측 가능성과 유연성에 대해 생각해 보십시오.

segments.src: Medigap typically means higher monthly premiums but fewer surprises and wide provider choice.
segments.tr: 메디가프는 일반적으로 월 보험료가 높지만 놀라움이 적고 광범위한 의료 제공자를 선택할 수 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Advantage plans often have lower premiums and extra benefits but come with network rules and cost-sharing that varies by service.
segments.tr: 어드밴티지 플랜은 종종 더 낮은 보험료와 추가 혜택을 제공하지만 네트워크 규칙 및 서비스에 따라 다른 비용 분담이 수반됩니다.

segments.src: ## Beware of Common Pitfalls
segments.tr: ## Beware of Common Pitfalls

segments.src: - **Aggressive marketing.** Be cautious about unsolicited calls, mailers and ads. Legitimate Medicare plans cannot generally call you unprompted to sell a plan, and you should never share your Medicare number with someone you do not trust.
segments.tr: - **Aggressive marketing.** Be cautious about unsolicited calls, mailers and ads. Legitimate Medicare plans cannot generally call you unprompted to sell a plan, and you should never share your Medicare number with someone you do not trust.

segments.src: - **Assuming auto-renewal is automatic savings.** Staying put is convenient, but premiums, networks and drug lists change. A quick review can reveal a better fit or catch a cost increase.
segments.tr: - **Assuming auto-renewal is automatic savings.** Staying put is convenient, but premiums, networks and drug lists change. A quick review can reveal a better fit or catch a cost increase.

segments.src: - **Reporting inaccurate income.** For marketplace plans, a big difference between estimated and actual income can result in repaying part of your credit at tax time.

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites get busy near deadlines, and a missed window may leave you without coverage options until the next open enrollment unless you qualify for a special enrollment period due to a life event.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line

segments.src: ## Question 1: What Will This Plan Really Cost Me?

segments.src: - **Premium:** The fixed monthly amount. For marketplace plans, this is the figure *after* any premium tax credit. Enter accurate income and household information on the application, since the credit depends on your expected income for the coming year.

segments.src: - **Deductible:** What you pay before the plan starts sharing costs for many services.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance:** Flat fees or percentages you pay for visits, tests, procedures and prescriptions.

segments.tr: - **मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज ओपन एनरोलमेंट (1 जनवरी – 31 मार्च):** मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज योजना में पहले से मौजूद लोग इस अवधि के दौरान एक बदलाव कर सकते हैं, जैसे कि दूसरी एडवांटेज योजना में स्विच करना या ओरिजिनल मेडिकेयर में वापस लौटना। यह सभी के लिए दूसरा मौका नहीं है, इसलिए जांच लें कि क्या यह आप पर लागू होता है।

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (Jan. 1 – March 31):** People already in a Medicare Advantage plan can make one change during this period, such as switching to another Advantage plan or returning to Original Medicare. It is not a second chance for everyone, so check whether it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **ACA मार्केटप्लेस (राज्य के अनुसार अलग-अलग):** HealthCare.gov पर, मानक पैटर्न 1 जनवरी से शुरू होने वाले कवरेज के लिए 15 दिसंबर तक नामांकित होना रहा है, जिसमें बाद में शुरू होने वाले कवरेज के लिए जनवरी के मध्य तक खुला नामांकन जारी रहता है। कुछ राज्य द्वारा संचालित मार्केटप्लेस अपनी खुद की तारीखें तय करते हैं, और कुछ उन्हें बढ़ाते हैं। इसकी सटीक अनुसूची के लिए अपने राज्य के एक्सचेंज की जाँच करें।

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace (varies by state):** On HealthCare.gov, the standard pattern has been to enroll by Dec. 15 for coverage starting Jan. 1, with open enrollment continuing into mid-January for coverage that starts later. Some state-run marketplaces set their own dates, and a few extend them. Check your state's exchange for its exact schedule.
segments.tr: - **नियोक्ता योजनाएं:** यदि आपको काम पर कवरेज मिलता है, तो आपकी कंपनी अपनी खुद की नामांकन खिड़की तय करती है, अक्सर पतझड़ में। यह मार्गदर्शिका मेडिकेयर और मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं पर केंद्रित है।

segments.src: - **Employer plans:** If you get coverage at work, your company sets its own enrollment window, often in the fall. This guide focuses on Medicare and marketplace plans.
segments.tr: यदि आप 65 वर्ष के हो रहे हैं या नए पात्र हैं, तो आपकी प्रारंभिक नामांकन अवधि वार्षिक खिड़की से अलग काम करती है।

segments.src: If you are turning 65 or are newly eligible, your Initial Enrollment Period works differently from the annual window.
segments.tr: इसे याद करने से मेडिकेयर के कुछ हिस्सों के लिए देर से नामांकन दंड हो सकता है, इसलिए अपनी व्यक्तिगत तारीखों को देखें।

segments.src: Missing it can lead to late-enrollment penalties for some parts of Medicare, so look up your personal dates.
segments.tr: ## प्रश्न 1: इस योजना की वास्तव में मुझे कितनी लागत आएगी?

segments.src: ## Question 1: What Will This Plan Really Cost Me?
segments.tr: मासिक प्रीमियम वह संख्या है जिसे लोग पहले नोटिस करते हैं, लेकिन यह लागत का केवल एक हिस्सा है।

segments.src: The monthly premium is the number people notice first, but it is only one piece of the cost.
segments.tr: - **प्रीमियम:** निश्चित मासिक राशि। मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं के लिए, यह किसी भी प्रीमियम टैक्स क्रेडिट के *बाद* का आंकड़ा है। आवेदन पर सटीक आय और घरेलू जानकारी दर्ज करें, क्योंकि क्रेडिट आने वाले वर्ष के लिए आपकी अपेक्षित आय पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: - **Premium:** The fixed monthly amount. For marketplace plans, this is the figure *after* any premium tax credit. Enter accurate income and household information on the application, since the credit depends on your expected income for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **डिडक्टिबल:** कई सेवाओं के लिए योजना लागत साझा करना शुरू करने से पहले आप जो भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Deductible:** What you pay before the plan starts sharing costs for many services.
segments.tr: - **कोपैय और कोइंश्योरेंस:** विज़िट, परीक्षणों, प्रक्रियाओं और नुस्खों के लिए आप जो फ्लैट शुल्क या प्रतिशत भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance:** Flat fees or percentages you pay for visits, tests, procedures and prescriptions.
segments.tr: - **आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट अधिकतम:** कवर किए गए, इन-नेटवर्क देखभाल के लिए आप एक वर्ष में सबसे अधिक भुगतान कर सकते हैं। उसके बाद, योजना कवर की गई लागतों का भुगतान करती है।

segments.src: - **Out-of-pocket maximum:** The most you could pay in a year for covered, in-network care. After that, the plan pays covered costs.
segments.tr: कम प्रीमियम वाली योजना पर उच्च डिडक्टिबल हो सकता है।

segments.src: A plan with a low premium may carry a high deductible.
segments.tr: यदि आप नियमित देखभाल की उम्मीद करते हैं तो उच्च प्रीमियम वाली योजना कुल मिलाकर कम खर्च कर सकती है।

segments.src: A plan with a higher premium may cost less overall if you expect regular care.
segments.tr: एक उपयोगी अभ्यास आपके संभावित वर्ष का अनुमान लगाना है: आप कितने डॉक्टर के दौरे, विशेषज्ञ की नियुक्तियों, नुस्खों और संभावित प्रक्रियाओं की उम्मीद करते हैं, और फिर यह जोड़ना है कि प्रत्येक योजना क्या शुल्क लेगी।

segments.src: A useful exercise is to estimate your likely year: how many doctor visits, specialist appointments, prescriptions and possible procedures you expect, and then add up what each plan would charge.
segments.tr: ## मार्केटप्लेस सब्सिडी पर एक नोट

segments.src: ### A Note on Marketplace Subsidies
segments.tr: प्रीमियम टैक्स क्रेडिट का आकार संघीय कानून द्वारा निर्धारित किया जाता है और हाल के वर्षों में बदल गया है।

segments.src: The size of premium tax credits is set by federal law and has changed in recent years.
segments.tr: यह न मानें कि पिछले साल की कीमत दोहराई जाएगी।

segments.src: Do not assume last year's price will repeat.
segments.tr: पिछले अनुभव पर भरोसा करने के बजाय, आधिकारिक मार्केटप्लेस के विंडो-शॉपिंग टूल या प्लान फाइंडर का उपयोग करके अपने वास्तविक 2027 उद्धरण की तुलना करें।

segments.src: Compare your actual 2027 quote, using the official marketplace's window-shopping tools or the Plan Finder, rather than relying on past experience.
segments.tr: लागत-साझाकरण में कटौती के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त करने वाले परिवारों को सिल्वर-स्तरीय योजनाओं को करीब से देखना चाहिए, जो पात्र नामांकित व्यक्तियों के लिए डिडक्टिबल और कोपैय को कम कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: Households that qualify for cost-sharing reductions should look closely at Silver-level plans, which can lower deductibles and copays for eligible enrollees.
segments.tr: ## प्रश्न 2: क्या मेरे डॉक्टर और अस्पताल नेटवर्क में हैं?

segments.src: ## Question 2: Are My Doctors and Hospitals In the Network?
segments.tr: नेटवर्क सबसे आम कारणों में से एक हैं जिससे लोग योजना के चयन पर पछतावा करते हैं।

segments.src: Networks are one of the most common reasons people regret a plan choice.
segments.tr: - **आपके द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले प्रत्येक डॉक्टर, विशेषज्ञ और अस्पताल को** योजना की अपनी प्रदाता निर्देशिका में देखें, और कार्यालय के साथ फोन द्वारा पुष्टि करें। निर्देशिका पुरानी हो सकती है।

segments.src: - **Look up each doctor, specialist and hospital you use** in the plan's own provider directory, and confirm by phone with the office. Directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **योजना के प्रकार को समझें।** HMO योजनाओं के लिए आमतौर पर आपको इन-नेटवर्क प्रदाताओं का उपयोग करने की आवश्यकता होती है और इसके लिए रेफरल की आवश्यकता हो सकती है। PPO योजनाएं आम तौर पर अधिक लागत पर अधिक लचीलापन प्रदान करती हैं। EPO योजनाएं आमतौर पर आपात स्थिति को छोड़कर आउट-ऑफ-नेटवर्क देखभाल को कवर नहीं करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Understand the plan type.** HMO plans usually require you to use in-network providers and may require referrals. PPO plans generally offer more flexibility at higher cost. EPO plans typically do not cover out-of-network care except in emergencies.
segments.tr: - **ओरिजिनल मेडिकेयर बनाम मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज:** ओरिजिनल मेडिकेयर को देश भर के अधिकांश डॉक्टरों और अस्पतालों द्वारा स्वीकार किया जाता है जो मेडिकेयर लेते हैं। मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज योजनाएं नेटवर्क का उपयोग करती हैं और अक्सर अतिरिक्त शामिल करती हैं, लेकिन वे आपको स्थानीय क्षेत्र तक सीमित कर सकती हैं और कुछ सेवाओं के लिए पूर्व प्राधिकरण की आवश्यकता हो सकती है।

segments.src: - **Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage:** Original Medicare is accepted by most doctors and hospitals nationwide that take Medicare. Medicare Advantage plans use networks and often include extras, but they may restrict you to a local area and may require prior authorization for some services.
segments.tr: - **जांचें कि आप वर्ष के किस हिस्से में यात्रा करते हैं या रहते हैं।** यदि आप महीने दूर बिताते हैं, तो पुष्टि करें कि योजना अपने गृह क्षेत्र के बाहर क्या कवर करती है।

segments.src: - **Check where you travel or live part of the year.** If you spend months away, confirm what the plan covers outside its home area.
segments.tr: ## प्रश्न 3: क्या यह मेरी प्रिस्क्रिप्शन दवाओं को कवर करता है?

segments.src: ## Question 3: Does It Cover My Prescription Drugs?
segments.tr: दवा कवरेज साल-दर-साल बदल सकता है, तब भी जब आप एक ही योजना के साथ बने रहते हैं।

segments.src: Drug coverage can change from year to year, even when you stay with the same plan.
segments.tr: - **फॉर्म्यूलरी की जांच करें** (योजना की कवर की गई दवाओं की सूची) आपके द्वारा ली जाने वाली हर दवा के लिए, खुराक और रूप सहित।

segments.src: - **Check the formulary** (the plan's list of covered drugs) for every medication you take, including the dose and form.
segments.tr: - **उस टियर को देखें** जिसमें प्रत्येक दवा आती है, क्योंकि उच्च टियर अधिक महंगे होते हैं।

segments.src: - **Look at the tier** each drug falls into, since higher tiers cost more.
segments.tr: - **पूर्व प्राधिकरण, स्टेप थेरेपी (पहले सस्ती दवा की कोशिश करना) और मात्रा सीमा जैसे प्रतिबंधों के बारे में पूछें।**

segments.src: - **Ask about restrictions** such as prior authorization, step therapy (trying a cheaper drug first) and quantity limits.
segments.tr: - **अपनी फार्मेसी की पुष्टि करें।** कुछ योजनाएं पसंदीदा फार्मेसियों में कम कीमतें प्रदान करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Confirm your pharmacy.** Some plans offer lower prices at preferred pharmacies.
segments.tr: - **अपनी वार्षिक परिवर्तन सूचना पढ़ें।** मेडिकेयर योजनाएं इस दस्तावेज को पतझड़ में भेजती हैं। यह अगले साल के लिए लागत, कवरेज और नेटवर्क में बदलाव की व्याख्या करता है, और इसे अनदेਖ करना आसान है।

segments.src: - **Read your Annual Notice of Change.** Medicare plans send this document in the fall. It explains changes to costs, coverage and networks for next year, and it is easy to overlook.
segments.tr: मेडिकेयर पार्ट डी के लिए, मुद्रास्फीति में कमी अधिनियम द्वारा किए गए परिवर्तनों के कारण, कवर किए गए दवा खर्च पर वार्षिक आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट कैप अब मौजूद है।

segments.src: For Medicare Part D, an annual out-of-pocket cap on covered drug spending now exists, thanks to changes made by the Inflation Reduction Act.
segments.tr: यह कैप 2025 में $2,000 थी और बाद के वर्षों में मुद्रास्फीति के लिए समायोजित की जाती है।

segments.src: The cap was $2,000 in 2025 and is adjusted for inflation in later years.
segments.tr: सटीक 2027 आंकड़े के लिए मेडिकेयर प्लान फाइंडर की जाँच करें।

segments.src: Check the Medicare Plan Finder for the exact 2027 figure.
segments.tr: कई योजनाएं मेडिकेयर प्रिस्क्रिप्शन पेमेंट प्लान भी प्रदान करती हैं, जो आपको एक बार में भुगतान करने के बजाय मासिक किस्तों में वर्ष भर आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट दवा लागत फैलाने देती हैं।

segments.src: Many plans also offer the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which lets you spread out-of-pocket drug costs across the year in monthly installments instead of paying all at once.
segments.tr: लागत फैलाने से कुल कम नहीं होता है।

segments.src: Spreading the cost does not lower the total.
segments.tr: ## प्रश्न 4: सबसे खराब स्थिति क्या है?

segments.src: ## Question 4: What Is the Worst-Case Scenario?
segments.tr: आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट कैप वे हैं जो आपको बहुत महंगी बीमारी या दुर्घटना से बचाते हैं।

segments.src: Out-of-pocket caps are what protect you from a very expensive illness or accident.
segments.tr: - **ACA मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं** में इन-नेटवर्क, कवर की गई आवश्यक स्वास्थ्य लाभों पर आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट खर्च पर संघीय वार्षिक सीमा होती है। सीमा को प्रत्येक वर्ष समायोजित किया जाता है और यह एक व्यक्ति के लिए पर्याप्त है, इसलिए उस योजना वर्ष के लिए आंकड़े को देखें जिसे आप चुन रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace plans** have a federal annual limit on out-of-pocket spending for in-network, covered essential health benefits. The limit is adjusted each year and is substantial for an individual, so look up the figure for the plan year you are choosing.
segments.tr: - **मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज योजनाओं** में पार्ट ए और पार्ट बी सेवाओं के लिए इन-नेटवर्क आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट लागतों पर वार्षिक सीमा शामिल होनी चाहिए। सीमाएं योजना के अनुसार भिन्न होती हैं।

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage plans** must include an annual limit on in-network out-of-pocket costs for Part A and Part B services. Limits differ by plan.
segments.tr: - **ओरिजिनल मेडिकेयर** में पार्ट्स ए और बी के लिए कोई वार्षिक आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट कैप नहीं है। कई लोग उस अंतर को भरने में मदद करने के लिए मेडिगाप (मेडिकेयर सप्लीमेंट) नीति जोड़ते हैं या अन्य कवरेज रखते हैं, जैसे कि सेवानिवृत्त या नियोक्ता लाभ। मेडिगाप नीतियां अलग से बेची जाती हैं, और बिना मेडिकल अंडरराइटिंग के एक को खरीदने का आपका सबसे अच्छा समय आमतौर पर आपकी मेडिगाप ओपन एनरोलमेंट अवधि के दौरान होता है, इसलिए अपने राज्य के नियमों की जाँच करें।

segments.src: - **Original Medicare** has no annual out-of-pocket cap for Parts A and B. Many people add a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy or have other coverage, such as retiree or employer benefits, to help fill that gap. Medigap policies are sold separately, and your best time to buy one without medical underwriting is usually during your Medigap open enrollment period, so check the rules in your state.
segments.tr: यदि आप मेडिगाप के साथ ओरिजिनल मेडिकेयर को मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज के मुकाबले तौल रहे हैं, तो लचीलेपन के मुकाबले पूर्वानुमेयता के बारे में सोचें।

segments.src: If you are weighing Original Medicare with Medigap against Medicare Advantage, think about predictability versus flexibility.
segments.tr: मेडिगाप का आमतौर पर मतलब उच्च मासिक प्रीमियम होता है लेकिन कम आश्चर्य और व्यापक प्रदाता विकल्प होता है।

segments.src: Medigap typically means higher monthly premiums but fewer surprises and wide provider choice.
segments.tr: एडवांटेज योजनाओं में अक्सर कम प्रीमियम और अतिरिक्त लाभ होते हैं लेकिन नेटवर्क नियमों और लागत-साझाकरण के साथ आते हैं जो सेवा के आधार पर भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: Advantage plans often have lower premiums and extra benefits but come with network rules and cost-sharing that varies by service.
segments.tr: ## प्रश्न 5: वास्तव में मैं किन अतिरिक्त लाभों का उपयोग करता हूँ?

segments.src: ## Question 5: What Extra Benefits Do I Actually Use?
segments.tr: योजनाएं, विशेष रूप से मेडिकेयर एडवांटेज योजनाएं, दंत, दृष्टि, श्रवण, जिम सदस्यता और ओवर-द-काउंटर भत्ते का विज्ञापन करती हैं।

segments.src: Plans, particularly Medicare Advantage plans, advertise dental, vision, hearing, gym memberships and over-the-counter allowances.
segments.tr: ये मूल्यवान हो सकते हैं, लेकिन तभी जब आप उनका उपयोग करें।

segments.src: These can be valuable, but only if you use them.
segments.tr: - डॉलर सीमा की जाँच करें और क्या कवर किया गया है।

segments.src: - Check the dollar limits and what is covered.

segments.src: - Look at whether your own dentist or eye doctor participates.
segments.tr: - प्रीमियम या लागत-साझाकरण में किसी भी अंतर के साथ इन अतिरिक्त के मूल्य की तुलना करें।

segments.src: - Compare the value of these extras to any difference in premiums or cost-sharing.
segments.tr: ## एक व्यावहारिक चरण-दर-चरण चेकलिस्ट

segments.src: ## A Practical Step-by-Step Checklist
segments.tr: 1. **आज ही कैलेंडर पर अपनी समय सीमा को चिह्नित करें,** उस तिथि सहित जिसके द्वारा आपको 1 जनवरी को शुरू होने वाले कवरेज के लिए कार्य करने की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: 1. **Mark your deadlines** on a calendar today, including the date by which you need to act for coverage to begin Jan. 1.
segments.tr: 2. **अपनी जानकारी एकत्र करें:** डॉक्टरों की एक सूची, खुराक के साथ दवाएं, पसंदीदा फार्मेसी, अपेक्षित आय (मार्केटप्लेस सब्सिडी के लिए) और आपके वर्तमान योजना दस्तावेज।

segments.src: 2. **Gather your information:** a list of doctors, medications with doses, preferred pharmacy, expected income (for marketplace subsidies) and your current plan documents.
segments.tr: 3. **यह मानने से पहले कि यह समान रहेगा, अपनी वर्तमान योजना की परिवर्तन सूचना पढ़ें।**

segments.src: 3. **Read your current plan's notice of changes** before assuming it will stay the same.
segments.tr: 4. **आधिकारिक तुलना टूल का उपयोग करें:** मेडिकेयर के लिए Medicare.gov का प्लान फाइंडर, और मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं के लिए HealthCare.gov या आपका राज्य एक्सचेंज।

segments.src: 4. **Use official comparison tools:** Medicare.gov's Plan Finder for Medicare, and HealthCare.gov or your state exchange for marketplace plans.
segments.tr: 5. **कुल अपेक्षित लागत की तुलना करें,** न कि केवल प्रीमियम: प्रीमियम और संभावित आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट खर्च, आपके सबसे खराब मामले के रूप में आउट-ऑफ-पॉकेट अधिकतम के साथ।

segments.src: 5. **Compare total expected cost,** not just premium: premium plus likely out-of-pocket spending, with the out-of-pocket maximum as your worst case.
segments.tr: 6. **फोन द्वारा नेटवर्क और फॉर्म्यूलरी को सत्यापित करें,** न कि केवल ऑनलाइन।

segments.src: 6. **Verify networks and formularies by phone,** not only online.
segments.tr: 7. **मुफ्त, निष्पक्ष सहायता प्राप्त करें।** स्टेट हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस असिस्टेंस प्रोग्राम (SHIPs) मेडिकेयर पर मुफ्त परामर्श प्रदान करते हैं। मार्केटप्लेस नेविगेटर और प्रमाणित आवेदन परामर्शदाता बिना किसी शुल्क के ACA नामांकन में मदद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 7. **Get free, unbiased help.** State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs) offer free counseling on Medicare. Marketplace navigators and certified application counselors can help with ACA enrollment at no charge.
segments.tr: 8. **अपने नामांकन की पुष्टि सहेजें** और अपने पहले बिल और बीमा कार्ड देखें।

segments.src: 8. **Save confirmation** of your enrollment and watch for your first bill and insurance cards.
segments.tr: ## सामान्य कमियों से सावधान रहें

segments.src: ## Beware of Common Pitfalls
segments.tr: - **आक्रामक विपणन।** अवांछित कॉल, मेलर और विज्ञापनों के बारे में सतर्क रहें। वैध मेडिकेयर योजनाएं आम तौर पर किसी योजना को बेचने के लिए आपको बिना बुलाए कॉल नहीं कर सकती हैं, और आपको कभी भी किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के साथ अपना मेडिकेयर नंबर साझा नहीं करना चाहिए जिस पर आप भरोसा नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Aggressive marketing.** Be cautious about unsolicited calls, mailers and ads. Legitimate Medicare plans cannot generally call you unprompted to sell a plan, and you should never share your Medicare number with someone you do not trust.
segments.tr: - **ऑटो-नवीनीकरण को स्वचालित बचत मानना।** जगह पर बने रहना सुविधाजनक है, लेकिन प्रीमियम, नेटवर्क और दवा सूची बदलती है। एक त्वरित समीक्षा बेहतर फिट का खुलासा कर सकती है या लागत में वृद्धि को पकड़ सकती है।

segments.src: - **Assuming auto-renewal is automatic savings.** Staying put is convenient, but premiums, networks and drug lists change. A quick review can reveal a better fit or catch a cost increase.
segments.tr: - **अटीक आय की रिपोर्ट करना।** मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं के लिए, अनुमानित और वास्तविक आय के बीच एक बड़ा अंतर कर के समय आपके क्रेडिट का हिस्सा चुकाने का परिणाम हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Reporting inaccurate income.** For marketplace plans, a big difference between estimated and actual income can result in repaying part of your credit at tax time.
segments.tr: - **अंतिम दिन तक प्रतीक्षा करना।** समय सीमा के करीब वेबसाइटें व्यस्त हो जाती हैं, और एक छूटी हुई खिड़की आपको अगली खुली नामांकन तक बिना कवरेज विकल्पों के छोड़ सकती है जब तक कि आप जीवन की घटना के कारण विशेष नामांकन अवधि के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites get busy near deadlines, and a missed window may leave you without coverage options until the next open enrollment unless you qualify for a special enrollment period due to a life event.
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: खुला नामांकन यह सुनिश्चित करने का एक सीमित समय का मौका है कि आपका कवरेज आपकी स्वास्थ्य आवश्यकताओं और आपके बजट से मेल खाता है।

segments.src: Open enrollment is a limited-time chance to make sure your coverage matches your health needs and your budget.
segments.tr: इसे अच्छी तरह से करने के लिए आपको बीमा विशेषज्ञ होने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

segments.src: You do not need to be an insurance expert to do it well.
segments.tr: पाँच चीज़ों पर ध्यान दें: आप वास्तव में क्या भुगतान करेंगे, क्या आपके डॉक्टर नेटवर्क में हैं, क्या आपकी दवाएं कवर की गई हैं, आप एक बुरे वर्ष में कितना भुगतान कर सकते हैं, और आप किन अतिरिक्त चीज़ों का उपयोग करेंगे।

segments.src: Focus on five things: what you will really pay, whether your doctors are in the network, whether your drugs are covered, how much you could pay in a bad year, and which extras you will use.
segments.tr: फिर आधिकारिक स्रोतों और एक मुफ्त परामर्शदाता के साथ तथ्यों की पुष्टि करें, और समय सीमा आने से पहले अपना निर्णय लें।

segments.src: Then confirm the facts with official sources and a free counselor, and make your decision before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: *समय सीमा, लाभ राशि और सब्सिडी नियम बदलते हैं।

segments.src: *Deadlines, benefit amounts and subsidy rules change.

segments.src: Verify current details at Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov or your state marketplace, and consult a licensed professional for advice about your situation.*

segments.src: ## Know Which Calendar Applies to You
segments.tr: ## Sepa qué calendario se aplica a usted

segments.src: Start by identifying which system you belong to, because the dates differ.
segments.tr: Comience por identificar a qué sistema pertenece, porque las fechas difieren.

segments.src: - **Medicare (Oct. 15 – Dec. 7):** During this window, people already in Medicare can switch between Original Medicare and a Medicare Advantage plan, change Advantage plans, or join, switch or drop a Part D prescription drug plan. Changes generally take effect Jan. 1.
segments.tr: - **Medicare (15 de oct. – 7 de dic.):** Durante este periodo, las personas que ya están en Medicare pueden cambiar entre Medicare Original y un plan Medicare Advantage, cambiar de plan Advantage, o inscribirse, cambiar o cancelar un plan de medicamentos recetados de la Parte D. Los cambios generalmente entran en vigor el 1 de enero.

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (Jan. 1 – March 31):** People already in a Medicare Advantage plan can make one change during this period, such as switching to another Advantage plan or returning to Original Medicare. It is not a second chance for everyone, so check whether it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Inscripción Abierta de Medicare Advantage (1 de ene. – 31 de marzo):** Las personas que ya están en un plan Medicare Advantage pueden hacer un cambio durante este periodo, como cambiar a otro plan Advantage o regresar a Medicare Original. No es una segunda oportunidad para todos, así que verifique si se aplica a usted.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace (varies by state):** On HealthCare.gov, the standard pattern has been to enroll by Dec. 15 for coverage starting Jan. 1, with open enrollment continuing into mid-January for coverage that starts later. Some state-run marketplaces set their own dates, and a few extend them. Check your state's exchange for its exact schedule.
segments.tr: - **Mercado de la ACA (varía según el estado):** En HealthCare.gov, el patrón estándar ha sido inscribirse antes del 15 de diciembre para tener cobertura a partir del 1 de enero, y la inscripción abierta continúa hasta mediados de enero para la cobertura que comienza más tarde. Algunos mercados administrados por el estado establecen sus propias fechas y algunos las extienden. Consulte el intercambio de su estado para ver su horario exacto.

segments.src: - **Employer plans:** If you get coverage at work, your company sets its own enrollment window, often in the fall. This guide focuses on Medicare and marketplace plans.
segments.tr: - **Planes de empleador:** Si obtiene cobertura en el trabajo, su empresa establece su propio periodo de inscripción, a menudo en el otoño. Esta guía se centra en los planes de Medicare y del mercado.

segments.src: If you are turning 65 or are newly eligible, your Initial Enrollment Period works differently from the annual window.
segments.tr: Si cumple 65 años o es elegible recientemente, su Periodo de Inscripción Inicial funciona de manera diferente al periodo anual.

segments.src: Missing it can lead to late-enrollment penalties for some parts of Medicare, so look up your personal dates.
segments.tr: Perderlo puede generar multas por inscripción tardía para algunas partes de Medicare, así que busque sus fechas personales.

segments.src: ## Question 1: What Will This Plan Really Cost Me?
segments.tr: ## Pregunta 1: ¿Cuánto me costará realmente este plan?

segments.src: The monthly premium is the number people notice first, but it is only one piece of the cost.
segments.tr: La prima mensual es la cifra que la gente nota primero, pero es solo una parte del costo.

segments.src: - **Premium:** The fixed monthly amount. For marketplace plans, this is the figure *after* any premium tax credit. Enter accurate income and household information on the application, since the credit depends on your expected income for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Prima:** La cantidad mensual fija. Para los planes del mercado, esta es la cifra *después* de cualquier crédito fiscal para las primas. Ingrese información precisa sobre ingresos y hogar en la solicitud, ya que el crédito depende de sus ingresos esperados para el próximo año.

segments.src: - **Deductible:** What you pay before the plan starts sharing costs for many services.
segments.tr: - **Deducible:** Lo que paga antes de que el plan comience a compartir los costos de muchos servicios.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance:** Flat fees or percentages you pay for visits, tests, procedures and prescriptions.
segments.tr: - **Copagos y curoseguro:** Tarifas fijas o porcentajes que paga por visitas, pruebas, procedimientos y recetas.

segments.src: - **Out-of-pocket maximum:** The most you could pay in a year for covered, in-network care. After that, the plan pays covered costs.
segments.tr: - **Máximo de gastos de su bolsillo:** Lo máximo que podría pagar en un año por atención cubierta dentro de la red. Después de eso, el plan paga los costos cubiertos.

segments.src: A plan with a low premium may carry a high deductible.
segments.tr: Un plan con una prima baja puede tener un deducible alto.

segments.src: A plan with a higher premium may cost less overall if you expect regular care.
segments.tr: Un plan con una prima más alta puede costar menos en general si espera atención regular.

segments.src: A useful exercise is to estimate your likely year: how many doctor visits, specialist appointments, prescriptions and possible procedures you expect, and then add up what each plan would charge.
segments.tr: Un ejercicio útil es estimar su año probable: cuántas visitas al médico, citas con especialistas, recetas y posibles procedimientos espera, y luego sumar lo que cobraría cada plan.

segments.src: ### A Note on Marketplace Subsidies
segments.tr: ### Una nota sobre los subsidios del mercado

segments.src: The size of premium tax credits is set by federal law and has changed in recent years.
segments.tr: El tamaño de los créditos fiscales para las primas está establecido por la ley federal y ha cambiado en los últimos años.

segments.src: Do not assume last year's price will repeat.
segments.tr: No asuma que el precio del año pasado se repetirá.

segments.src: Compare your actual 2027 quote, using the official marketplace's window-shopping tools or the Plan Finder, rather than relying on past experience.
segments.tr: Compare su cotización real para 2027, utilizando las herramientas de compra de escaparates del mercado oficial o el Buscador de Planes, en lugar de confiar en experiencias pasadas.

segments.src: Households that qualify for cost-sharing reductions should look closely at Silver-level plans, which can lower deductibles and copays for eligible enrollees.
segments.tr: Los hogares que califiquen para reducciones de costos compartidos deben observar de cerca los planes de nivel Plateado, que pueden reducir los deducibles y copagos para los inscritos elegibles.

segments.src: ## Question 2: Are My Doctors and Hospitals In the Network?
segments.tr: ## Pregunta 2: ¿Están mis médicos y hospitales en la red?

segments.src: Networks are one of the most common reasons people regret a plan choice.
segments.tr: Las redes son una de las razones más comunes por las que las personas se arrepienten de la elección de un plan.

segments.src: - **Look up each doctor, specialist and hospital you use** in the plan's own provider directory, and confirm by phone with the office. Directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **Busque a cada médico, especialista y hospital que utilice** en el propio directorio de proveedores del plan y confírmelo por teléfono con la oficina. Los directores pueden estar desactualizados.

segments.src: - **Understand the plan type.** HMO plans usually require you to use in-network providers and may require referrals. PPO plans generally offer more flexibility at higher cost. EPO plans typically do not cover out-of-network care except in emergencies.
segments.tr: - **Comprenda el tipo de plan.** Los planes HMO generalmente requieren que use proveedores dentro de la red y pueden requerir derivaciones. Los planes PPO generalmente ofrecen más flexibilidad a un costo mayor. Los planes EPO típicamente no cubren la atención fuera de la red, excepto en emergencias.

segments.src: - **Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage:** Original Medicare is accepted by most doctors and hospitals nationwide that take Medicare. Medicare Advantage plans use networks and often include extras, but they may restrict you to a local area and may require prior authorization for some services.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Original vs. Medicare Advantage:** Medicare Original es aceptado por la mayoría de los médicos y hospitales en todo el país que aceptan Medicare. Los planes Medicare Advantage utilizan redes y a menudo incluyen extras, pero pueden restringirlo a un área local y pueden requerir autorización previa para algunos servicios.

segments.src: - **Check where you travel or live part of the year.** If you spend months away, confirm what the plan covers outside its home area.
segments.tr: - **Verifique dónde viaja o vive parte del año.** Si pasa meses fuera, confirme qué cubre el plan fuera de su área de origen.

segments.src: ## Question 3: Does It Cover My Prescription Drugs?
segments.tr: ## Pregunta 3: ¿Cubre mis medicamentos recetados?

segments.src: Drug coverage can change from year to year, even when you stay with the same plan.
segments.tr: La cobertura de medicamentos puede cambiar de un año a otro, incluso cuando se queda con el mismo plan.

segments.src: - **Check the formulary** (the plan's list of covered drugs) for every medication you take, including the dose and form.
segments.tr: - **Consulte el formulario** (la lista de medicamentos cubiertos del plan) para cada medicamento que tome, incluida la dosis y la forma.

segments.src: - **Look at the tier** each drug falls into, since higher tiers cost more.
segments.tr: - **Mire el nivel** en el que cae cada medicamento, ya que los niveles más altos cuestan más.

segments.src: - **Ask about restrictions** such as prior authorization, step therapy (trying a cheaper drug first) and quantity limits.
segments.tr: - **Pregunte sobre restricciones** como autorización previa, terapia escalonada (probar primero un medicamento más barato) y límites de cantidad.

segments.src: - **Confirm your pharmacy.** Some plans offer lower prices at preferred pharmacies.
segments.tr: - **Confirme su farmacia.** Algunos planes ofrecen precios más bajos en farmacias preferidas.

segments.src: - **Read your Annual Notice of Change.** Medicare plans send this document in the fall. It explains changes to costs, coverage and networks for next year, and it is easy to overlook.
segments.tr: - **Lea su Aviso Anual de Cambio.** Los planes de Medicare envían este documento en el otoño. Explica los cambios en los costos, la cobertura y las redes para el próximo año, y es fácil pasarlo por alto.

segments.src: For Medicare Part D, an annual out-of-pocket cap on covered drug spending now exists, thanks to changes made by the Inflation Reduction Act.
segments.tr: Para la Parte D de Medicare, ahora existe un límite anual de bolsillo en el gasto de medicamentos cubiertos, gracias a los cambios realizados por la Ley de Reducción de la Inflación.

segments.src: The cap was $2,000 in 2025 and is adjusted for inflation in later years.
segments.tr: El límite fue de $2,000 en 2025 y se ajusta por inflación en años posteriores.

segments.src: Check the Medicare Plan Finder for the exact 2027 figure.
segments.tr: Consulte el Buscador de Planes de Medicare para obtener la cifra exacta de 2027.

segments.src: Many plans also offer the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which lets you spread out-of-pocket drug costs across the year in monthly installments instead of paying all at once.
segments.tr: Muchos planes también ofrecen el Plan de Pago de Medicamentos de Medicare, que le permite distribuir los costos de medicamentos de su bolsillo a lo largo del año en cuotas mensuales en lugar de pagar todo a la vez.

segments.src: Spreading the cost does not lower the total.
segments.tr: Extender el costo no reduce el total.

segments.src: ## Question 4: What Is the Worst-Case Scenario?
segments.tr: ## Pregunta 4: ¿Cuál es el peor escenario posible?

segments.src: Out-of-pocket caps are what protect you from a very expensive illness or accident.
segments.tr: Los límites de bolsillo son lo que le protege de una enfermedad o accidente muy costoso.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace plans** have a federal annual limit on out-of-pocket spending for in-network, covered essential health benefits. The limit is adjusted each year and is substantial for an individual, so look up the figure for the plan year you are choosing.
segments.tr: - **Los planes del mercado de la ACA** tienen un límite anual federal en el gasto de bolsillo para los beneficios de salud esenciales cubiertos dentro de la red. El límite se ajusta cada año y es sustancial para un individuo, así que busque la cifra para el año del plan que está eligiendo.

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage plans** must include an annual limit on in-network out-of-pocket costs for Part A and Part B services. Limits differ by plan.
segments.tr: - **Los planes Medicare Advantage** deben incluir un límite anual en los costos de bolsillo dentro de la red para los servicios de la Parte A y la Parte B. Los límites varían según el plan.

segments.src: - **Original Medicare** has no annual out-of-pocket cap for Parts A and B. Many people add a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy or have other coverage, such as retiree or employer benefits, to help fill that gap. Medigap policies are sold separately, and your best time to buy one without medical underwriting is usually during your Medigap open enrollment period, so check the rules in your state.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Original** no tiene un límite anual de bolsillo para las Partes A y B. Muchas personas agregan una póliza Medigap (Suplemento de Medicare) o tienen otra cobertura, como beneficios para jubilados o empleadores, para ayudar a llenar ese vacío. Las pólizas Medigap se venden por separado, y su mejor momento para comprar una sin suscripción médica suele ser durante su periodo de inscripción abierta de Medigap, así que consulte las reglas en su estado.

segments.src: If you are weighing Original Medicare with Medigap against Medicare Advantage, think about predictability versus flexibility.
segments.tr: Si está sopesando Medicare Original con Medigap frente a Medicare Advantage, piense en la previsibilidad frente a la flexibilidad.

segments.src: Medigap typically means higher monthly premiums but fewer surprises and wide provider choice.
segments.tr: Medigap generalmente significa primas mensuales más altas, pero menos sorpresas y una amplia opción de proveedores.

segments.src: Advantage plans often have lower premiums and extra benefits but come with network rules and cost-sharing that varies by service.
segments.tr: Los planes Advantage a menudo tienen primas más bajas y beneficios adicionales, pero vienen con reglas de red y costos compartidos que varían según el servicio.

segments.src: ## Question 5: What Extra Benefits Do I Actually Use?
segments.tr: ## Pregunta 5: ¿Qué beneficios adicionales uso realmente?

segments.src: Plans, particularly Medicare Advantage plans, advertise dental, vision, hearing, gym memberships and over-the-counter allowances.
segments.tr: Los planes, en particular los planes Medicare Advantage, anuncian dental, visión, audición, membresías de gimnasios y subsidios de venta libre.

segments.src: These can be valuable, but only if you use them.
segments.tr: Estos pueden ser valiosos, pero solo si los usa.

segments.src: - Check the dollar limits and what is covered.
segments.tr: - Verifique los límites en dólares y lo que está cubierto.

segments.src: - Look at whether your own dentist or eye doctor participates.
segments.tr: - Mire si su propio dentista u oculista participa.

segments.src: - Compare the value of these extras to any difference in premiums or cost-sharing.
segments.tr: - Compare el valor de estos extras con cualquier diferencia en las primas o los costos compartidos.

segments.src: ## A Practical Step-by-Step Checklist
segments.tr: ## Una lista de verificación práctica paso a paso

segments.src: 1. **Mark your deadlines** on a calendar today, including the date by which you need to act for coverage to begin Jan. 1.
segments.tr: 1. **Marque sus plazos límites** en un calendario hoy, incluida la fecha en la que necesita actuar para que la cobertura comience el 1 de enero.

segments.src: 2. **Gather your information:** a list of doctors, medications with doses, preferred pharmacy, expected income (for marketplace subsidies) and your current plan documents.
segments.tr: 2. **Reúna su información:** una lista de médicos, medicamentos con dosis, farmacia preferida, ingresos esperados (para subsidios del mercado) y sus documentos actuales del plan.

segments.src: 3. **Read your current plan's notice of changes** before assuming it will stay the same.
segments.tr: 3. **Lea el aviso de cambios de su plan actual** antes de asumir que seguirá siendo el mismo.

segments.src: 4. **Use official comparison tools:** Medicare.gov's Plan Finder for Medicare, and HealthCare.gov or your state exchange for marketplace plans.
segments.tr: 4. **Use herramientas de comparación oficiales:** el Buscador de Planes de Medicare.gov para Medicare, y HealthCare.gov o su intercambio estatal para los planes del mercado.

segments.src: 5. **Compare total expected cost,** not just premium: premium plus likely out-of-pocket spending, with the out-of-pocket maximum as your worst case.
segments.tr: 5. **Compare el costo total esperado,** no solo la prima: la prima más el gasto probable de bolsillo, con el máximo de bolsillo como su peor escenario.

segments.src: 6. **Verify networks and formularies by phone,** not only online.
segments.tr: 6. **Verifique las redes y formularios por teléfono,** no solo en línea.

segments.src: 7. **Get free, unbiased help.** State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs) offer free counseling on Medicare. Marketplace navigators and certified application counselors can help with ACA enrollment at no charge.
segments.tr: 7. **Obtenga ayuda gratuita e imparcial.** Los Programas Estatales de Asistencia con el Seguro Médico (SHIP) ofrecen asesoramiento gratuito sobre Medicare. Los navegadores del mercado y los consejeros de solicitudes certificados pueden ayudar con la inscripción en la ACA sin cargo.

segments.src: 8. **Save confirmation** of your enrollment and watch for your first bill and insurance cards.
segments.tr: 8. **Guarde la confirmación** de su inscripción y esté atento a su primera factura y tarjetas de seguro.

segments.src: ## Beware of Common Pitfalls
segments.tr: ## Tenga cuidado con los escollos comunes

segments.src: - **Aggressive marketing.** Be cautious about unsolicited calls, mailers and ads. Legitimate Medicare plans cannot generally call you unprompted to sell a plan, and you should never share your Medicare number with someone you do not trust.
segments.tr: - **Marketing agresivo.** Sea cauteloso con las llamadas no solicitadas, los correos y los anuncios. Los planes legítimos de Medicare generalmente no pueden llamarle sin previo aviso para venderle un plan, y nunca debe compartir su número de Medicare con alguien en quien no confíe.

segments.src: - **Assuming auto-renewal is automatic savings.** Staying put is convenient, but premiums, networks and drug lists change. A quick review can reveal a better fit or catch a cost increase.
segments.tr: - **Asumir que la renovación automática es un ahorro automático.** Quedarse en el mismo lugar es conveniente, pero las primas, las redes y las listas de medicamentos cambian. Una revisión rápida puede revelar un mejor ajuste o detectar un aumento de costos.

segments.src: - **Reporting inaccurate income.** For marketplace plans, a big difference between estimated and actual income can result in repaying part of your credit at tax time.
segments.tr: - **Informar ingresos inexactos.** Para los planes del mercado, una gran diferencia entre los ingresos estimados y los reales puede resultar en la devolución de parte de su crédito al momento de los impuestos.

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites get busy near deadlines, and a missed window may leave you without coverage options until the next open enrollment unless you qualify for a special enrollment period due to a life event.
segments.tr: - **Esperar hasta el último día.** Los sitios web se ocupan cerca de los plazos límites, y un periodo perdido puede dejarle sin opciones de cobertura hasta la próxima inscripción abierta a menos que califique para un periodo de inscripción especial debido a un evento de la vida.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: Open enrollment is a limited-time chance to make sure your coverage matches your health needs and your budget.
segments.tr: La inscripción abierta es una oportunidad de tiempo limitado para asegurarse de que su cobertura coincida con sus necesidades de salud y su presupuesto.

segments.src: You do not need to be an insurance expert to do it well.
segments.tr: No necesita ser un experto en seguros para hacerlo bien.

segments.src: Focus on five things: what you will really pay, whether your doctors are in the network, whether your drugs are covered, how much you could pay in a bad year, and which extras you will use.
segments.tr: Concéntrese en cinco cosas: lo que realmente pagará, si sus médicos están en la red, si sus medicamentos están cubiertos, cuánto podría pagar en un mal año y qué extras usará.

segments.src: Then confirm the facts with official sources and a free counselor, and make your decision before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Luego confirme los hechos con fuentes oficiales y un consejero gratuito, y tome su decisión antes de que llegue el plazo límite.

segments.src: *Deadlines, benefit amounts and subsidy rules change.
segments.tr: *Los plazos límites, las cantidades de beneficios y las reglas de subsidio cambian.

segments.src: Verify current details at Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov or your state marketplace, and consult a licensed professional for advice about your situation.*
segments.tr: Verifique los detalles actuales en Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov o su mercado estatal, y consulte a un profesional autorizado para obtener asesoramiento sobre su situación.*
