segments.tr: - **Medicare Asli vs. Medicare Advantage:** Medicare Asli diterima oleh sebagian besar dokter dan rumah sakit di seluruh negeri yang menerima Medicare. Paket Medicare Advantage menggunakan jaringan dan sering kali menyertakan tambahan, tetapi paket tersebut dapat membatasi Anda ke area lokal dan mungkin memerlukan otorisasi sebelumnya untuk beberapa layanan.

segments.src: - **Check where you travel or live part of the year.** If you spend months away, confirm what the plan covers outside its home area.
segments.tr: - **Periksa tempat Anda bepergian atau tinggal sebagian tahun.** Jika Anda menghabiskan waktu berbulan-bulan di luar, konfirmasikan apa yang dicakup oleh paket di luar area asalnya.

segments.src: ## Question 3: Does It Cover My Prescription Drugs?
segments.tr: ## Pertanyaan 3: Apakah Paket Ini Mencakup Obat Resep Saya?

segments.src: Drug coverage can change from year to year, even when you stay with the same plan.
segments.tr: Cakupan obat dapat berubah dari tahun ke tahun, bahkan ketika Anda tetap menggunakan paket yang sama.

segments.src: - **Check the formulary** (the plan's list of covered drugs) for every medication you take, including the dose and form.
segments.tr: - **Periksa formularium** (daftar obat yang dicakup oleh paket) untuk setiap obat yang Anda konsumsi, termasuk dosis dan bentuknya.

segments.src: - **Look at the tier** each drug falls into, since higher tiers cost more.
segments.tr: - **Lihat tingkat** tempat setiap obat berada, karena tingkat yang lebih tinggi lebih mahal.

segments.src: - **Ask about restrictions** such as prior authorization, step therapy (trying a cheaper drug first) and quantity limits.
segments.tr: - **Tanyakan tentang pembatasan** seperti otorisasi sebelumnya, terapi langkah (mencoba obat yang lebih murah terlebih dahulu), dan batas jumlah.

segments.src: - **Confirm your pharmacy.** Some plans offer lower prices at preferred pharmacies.
segments.tr: - **Konfirmasikan apotek Anda.** Beberapa paket menawarkan harga lebih rendah di apotek pilihan.

segments.src: - **Read your Annual Notice of Change.** Medicare plans send this document in the fall. It explains changes to costs, coverage and networks for next year, and it is easy to overlook.
segments.tr: - **Baca Pemberitahuan Perubahan Tahunan Anda.** Paket Medicare mengirimkan dokumen ini pada musim gugur. Dokumen ini menjelaskan perubahan biaya, cakupan, dan jaringan untuk tahun depan, dan mudah untuk diabaikan.

segments.src: For Medicare Part D, an annual out-of-pocket cap on covered drug spending now exists, thanks to changes made by the Inflation Reduction Act.
segments.tr: Untuk Medicare Bagian D, batas out-of-pocket tahunan untuk pengeluaran obat yang dicakup sekarang ada, berkat perubahan yang dibuat oleh Undang-Undang Pengurangan Inflasi.

segments.src: The cap was $2,000 in 2025 and is adjusted for inflation in later years.
segments.tr: Batasnya adalah $2.000 pada tahun 2025 dan disesuaikan untuk inflasi pada tahun-tahun berikutnya.

segments.src: Check the Medicare Plan Finder for the exact 2027 figure.
segments.tr: Periksa Pencari Paket Medicare untuk angka persis tahun 2027.

segments.src: Many plans also offer the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which lets you spread out-of-pocket drug costs across the year in monthly installments instead of paying all at once.
segments.tr: Banyak paket juga menawarkan Paket Pembayaran Resep Medicare, yang memungkinkan Anda menyebarkan biaya obat out-of-pocket sepanjang tahun dalam cicilan bulanan alih-alih membayar sekaligus.

segments.src: Spreading the cost does not lower the total.
segments.tr: Menyebarkan biaya tidak menurunkan totalnya.

segments.src: ## Question 4: What Is the Worst-Case Scenario?
segments.tr: ## Pertanyaan 4: Apa Skenario Terburuknya?

segments.src: Out-of-pocket caps are what protect you from a very expensive illness or accident.
segments.tr: Batas out-of-pocket adalah hal yang melindungi Anda dari penyakit atau kecelakaan yang sangat mahal.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace plans** have a federal annual limit on out-of-pocket spending for in-network, covered essential health benefits. The limit is adjusted each year and is substantial for an individual, so look up the figure for the plan year you are choosing.
segments.tr: - **Paket pasar ACA** memiliki batas tahunan federal untuk pengeluaran out-of-pocket untuk manfaat kesehatan esensial yang dicakup dalam jaringan. Batas tersebut disesuaikan setiap tahun dan cukup besar untuk individu, jadi carilah angka untuk tahun paket yang Anda pilih.

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage plans** must include an annual limit on in-network out-of-pocket costs for Part A and Part B services. Limits differ by plan.
segments.tr: - **Paket Medicare Advantage** harus menyertakan batas tahunan untuk biaya out-of-pocket dalam jaringan untuk layanan Bagian A dan Bagian B. Batas berbeda menurut paket.

segments.src: - **Original Medicare** has no annual out-of-pocket cap for Parts A and B. Many people add a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy or have other coverage, such as retiree or employer benefits, to help fill that gap. Medigap policies are sold separately, and your best time to buy one without medical underwriting is usually during your Medigap open enrollment period, so check the rules in your state.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Asli** tidak memiliki batas out-of-pocket tahunan untuk Bagian A dan B. Banyak orang menambahkan polis Medigap (Suplemen Medicare) atau memiliki pertanggungan lain, seperti pensiunan atau manfaat pemberi kerja, untuk membantu mengisi kesenjangan tersebut. Polis Medigap dijual secara terpisah, dan waktu terbaik Anda untuk membelinya tanpa penjaminan medis biasanya selama periode pendaftaran terbuka Medigap, jadi periksa aturan di negara bagian Anda.

segments.src: If you are weighing Original Medicare with Medigap against Medicare Advantage, think about predictability versus flexibility.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menimbang Medicare Asli dengan Medigap terhadap Medicare Advantage, pikirkan tentang prediktabilitas versus fleksibilitas.

segments.src: Medigap typically means higher monthly premiums but fewer surprises and wide provider choice.
segments.tr: Medigap biasanya berarti premi bulanan yang lebih tinggi tetapi lebih sedikit kejutan dan pilihan penyedia yang luas.

segments.src: Advantage plans often have lower premiums and extra benefits but come with network rules and cost-sharing that varies by service.
segments.tr: Paket Advantage sering kali memiliki premi yang lebih rendah dan manfaat tambahan tetapi datang dengan aturan jaringan dan pembagian biaya yang bervariasi menurut layanan.

segments.src: ## Question 5: What Extra Benefits Do I Actually Use?
segments.tr: ## Pertanyaan 5: Manfaat Tambahan Apa yang Sebenarnya Saya Gunakan?

segments.src: Plans, particularly Medicare Advantage plans, advertise dental, vision, hearing, gym memberships and over-the-counter allowances.
segments.tr: Paket, terutama paket Medicare Advantage, mengiklankan perawatan gigi, penglihatan, pendengaran, keanggotaan gym, dan tunjangan obat bebas.

segments.src: These can be valuable, but only if you use them.
segments.tr: Ini bisa berharga, tetapi hanya jika Anda menggunakannya.

segments.src: - Check the dollar limits and what is covered.
segments.tr: - Periksa batas dolar dan apa yang dicakup.

segments.src: - Look at whether your own dentist or eye doctor participates.
segments.tr: - Lihat apakah dokter gigi atau dokter mata Anda sendiri berpartisipasi.

segments.src: - Compare the value of these extras to any difference in premiums or cost-sharing.
segments.tr: - Bandingkan nilai tambahan ini dengan perbedaan premi atau pembagian biaya.

segments.src: ## A Practical Step-by-Step Checklist
segments.tr: ## Daftar Periksa Langkah demi Langkah Praktis

segments.src: 1. **Mark your deadlines** on a calendar today, including the date by which you need to act for coverage to begin Jan. 1.
segments.tr: 1. **Tandai tenggat waktu Anda** di kalender hari ini, termasuk tanggal di mana Anda harus bertindak agar pertanggungan dimulai 1 Jan.

segments.src: 2. **Gather your information:** a list of doctors, medications with doses, preferred pharmacy, expected income (for marketplace subsidies) and your current plan documents.
segments.tr: 2. **Kumpulkan informasi Anda:** daftar dokter, obat-obatan dengan dosisnya, apotek pilihan, perkiraan pendapatan (untuk subsidi pasar) dan dokumen paket Anda saat ini.

segments.src: 3. **Read your current plan's notice of changes** before assuming it will stay the same.
segments.tr: 3. **Baca pemberitahuan perubahan paket Anda saat ini** sebelum berasumsi bahwa paket akan tetap sama.

segments.src: 4. **Use official comparison tools:** Medicare.gov's Plan Finder for Medicare, and HealthCare.gov or your state exchange for marketplace plans.
segments.tr: 4. **Gunakan alat perbandingan resmi:** Pencari Paket Medicare.gov untuk Medicare, dan HealthCare.gov atau bursa negara bagian Anda untuk paket pasar.

segments.src: 5. **Compare total expected cost,** not just premium: premium plus likely out-of-pocket spending, with the out-of-pocket maximum as your worst case.
segments.tr: 5. **Bandingkan total perkiraan biaya,** bukan hanya premi: premi ditambah kemungkinan pengeluaran out-of-pocket, dengan maksimum out-of-pocket sebagai skenario terburuk Anda.

segments.src: 6. **Verify networks and formularies by phone,** not only online.
segments.tr: 6. **Verifikasi jaringan dan formularium melalui telepon,** bukan hanya secara online.

segments.src: 7. **Get free, unbiased help.** State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs) offer free counseling on Medicare. Marketplace navigators and certified application counselors can help with ACA enrollment at no charge.
segments.tr: 7. **Dapatkan bantuan gratis dan tidak bias.** Program Bantuan Asuransi Kesehatan Negara Bagian (SHIP) menawarkan konseling gratis tentang Medicare. Navigator pasar dan konselor aplikasi bersertifikat dapat membantu pendaftaran ACA tanpa biaya.

segments.src: 8. **Save confirmation** of your enrollment and watch for your first bill and insurance cards.
segments.tr: 8. **Simpan konfirmasi** pendaftaran Anda dan perhatikan tagihan pertama dan kartu asuransi Anda.

segments.src: ## Beware of Common Pitfalls
segments.tr: ## Waspadai Kendala Umum

segments.src: - **Aggressive marketing.** Be cautious about unsolicited calls, mailers and ads. Legitimate Medicare plans cannot generally call you unprompted to sell a plan, and you should never share your Medicare number with someone you do not trust.
segments.tr: - **Pemasaran agresif.** Berhati-hatilah terhadap panggilan tak diundang, surat, dan iklan. Paket Medicare yang sah umumnya tidak dapat menelepon Anda tanpa diminta untuk menjual paket, dan Anda tidak boleh membagikan nomor Medicare Anda kepada seseorang yang tidak Anda percayai.

segments.src: - **Assuming auto-renewal is automatic savings.** Staying put is convenient, but premiums, networks and drug lists change. A quick review can reveal a better fit or catch a cost increase.
segments.tr: - **Menganggap perpanjangan otomatis adalah penghematan otomatis.** Tetap tinggal sangat nyaman, tetapi premi, jaringan, dan daftar obat berubah. Tinjauan singkat dapat mengungkapkan kecocokan yang lebih baik atau menangkap kenaikan biaya.

segments.src: - **Reporting inaccurate income.** For marketplace plans, a big difference between estimated and actual income can result in repaying part of your credit at tax time.
segments.tr: - **Melaporkan pendapatan yang tidak akurat.** Untuk paket pasar, perbedaan besar antara perkiraan dan pendapatan aktual dapat mengakibatkan pembayaran kembali sebagian kredit Anda pada waktu pajak.

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites get busy near deadlines, and a missed window may leave you without coverage options until the next open enrollment unless you qualify for a special enrollment period due to a life event.
segments.tr: - **Menunggu sampai hari terakhir.** Situs web menjadi sibuk menjelang tenggat waktu, dan jendela yang terlewat dapat membuat Anda tidak memiliki opsi pertanggungan hingga pendaftaran terbuka berikutnya kecuali Anda memenuhi syarat untuk periode pendaftaran khusus karena suatu peristiwa kehidupan.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Open enrollment is a limited-time chance to make sure your coverage matches your health needs and your budget.
segments.tr: Pendaftaran terbuka adalah kesempatan waktu terbatas untuk memastikan pertanggungan Anda sesuai dengan kebutuhan kesehatan dan anggaran Anda.

segments.src: You do not need to be an insurance expert to do it well.
segments.tr: Anda tidak perlu menjadi ahli asuransi untuk melakukannya dengan baik.

segments.src: Focus on five things: what you will really pay, whether your doctors are in the network, whether your drugs are covered, how much you could pay in a bad year, and which extras you will use.
segments.tr: Fokus pada lima hal: apa yang sebenarnya akan Anda bayar, apakah dokter Anda ada di jaringan, apakah obat Anda dicakup, berapa banyak yang dapat Anda bayar di tahun yang buruk, dan tambahan mana yang akan Anda gunakan.

segments.src: Then confirm the facts with official sources and a free counselor, and make your decision before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Kemudian konfirmasikan faktanya dengan sumber resmi dan konselor gratis, dan buat keputusan Anda sebelum tenggat waktu tiba.

segments.src: *Deadlines, benefit amounts and subsidy rules change.
segments.tr: *Tenggat waktu, jumlah manfaat, dan aturan subsidi berubah.

segments.src: Verify current details at Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov or your state marketplace, and consult a licensed professional for advice about your situation.*
segments.tr: Verifikasi detail saat ini di Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov atau pasar negara bagian Anda, dan konsultasikan dengan profesional berlisensi untuk saran tentang situasi Anda.*

ja.title: オープン・エンロールメント・シーズン：期限前にACAマーケットプレイスとメディケアのプランを比較する方法

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans face the same set of choices: keep the health plan they have, or switch.
segments.tr: 毎年秋、何百万人ものアメリカ人が同じ選択に直面します。それは、加入中の健康保険を継続するか、それとも切り替えるかです。

segments.src: Medicare's annual enrollment period for most people runs from Oct.
segments.tr: ほとんどの人にとって、メディケアの年間加入期間は10月

segments.src: 15 to Dec.
segments.tr: 15日から12月

segments.src: 7, and most Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace deadlines fall in December or January.
segments.tr: 7日までであり、ほとんどの手頃な医療ケア法（ACA）マーケットプレイスの締切は12月または1月です。

segments.src: With the clock running, a short list of questions can help you compare plans in a clear, orderly way.
segments.tr: 時間が限られている中、いくつかの質問リストを使用することで、プランを明確かつ秩序ある方法で比較することができます。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not personal insurance, tax or legal advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報であり、個人の保険、税金、または法律上の助言ではありません。

segments.src: Rules, prices and deadlines vary by state and by plan, so confirm details with official sources before you decide.*
segments.tr: 規則、価格、および締切は州やプランによって異なるため、決定する前に公式情報源で詳細を確認してください.*

segments.src: ## Know Which Calendar Applies to You
segments.tr: ## 適用されるカレンダーを確認する

segments.src: Start by identifying which system you belong to, because the dates differ.
segments.tr: 日付が異なるため、自分がどのシステムに属しているかを特定することから始めます。

segments.src: - **Medicare (Oct. 15 – Dec. 7):** During this window, people already in Medicare can switch between Original Medicare and a Medicare Advantage plan, change Advantage plans, or join, switch or drop a Part D prescription drug plan. Changes generally take effect Jan. 1.
segments.tr: - **メディケア（10月15日〜12月7日）：** この期間中、すでにメディケアに加入している人は、オリジナル・メディケアとメディケア・アドバンテージ・プランの間で切り替えたり、アドバンテージ・プランを変更したり、パートD処方薬プランに加入、切り替え、または脱退したりすることができます。変更は通常1月1日に発効します。

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (Jan. 1 – March 31):** People already in a Medicare Advantage plan can make one change during this period, such as switching to another Advantage plan or returning to Original Medicare. It is not a second chance for everyone, so check whether it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **メディケア・アドバンテージ・オープン・エンロールメント（1月1日〜3月31日）：** すでにメディケア・アドバンテージ・プランに加入している人は、この期間中に別のプランへの切り替えやオリジナル・メディケアへの復帰など、1回だけ変更を行うことができます。すべての人にとっての2度目のチャンスというわけではないため、自分に適用されるかどうかを確認してください。

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace (varies by state):** On HealthCare.gov, the standard pattern has been to enroll by Dec. 15 for coverage starting Jan. 1, with open enrollment continuing into mid-January for coverage that starts later. Some state-run marketplaces set their own dates, and a few extend them. Check your state's exchange for its exact schedule.
segments.tr: - **ACAマーケットプレイス（州によって異なる）：** HealthCare.govでは、標準的なパターンとして1月1日開始のカバーのために12月15日までに加入し、オープン・エンロールメントは1月中旬まで継続してより遅くに開始するカバーに対応します。一部の州運営のマーケットプレイスは独自の期日を設定しており、延長するところもいくつかあります。正確なスケジュールについては、お住まいの州のエクスチェンジを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Employer plans:** If you get coverage at work, your company sets its own enrollment window, often in the fall. This guide focuses on Medicare and marketplace plans.
segments.tr: - **雇用主のプラン：** 職場から保険に加入している場合、会社が独自の加入期間を設定しており、多くは秋に行われます。このガイドでは、メディケアとマーケットプレイスのプランに焦点を当てています。

segments.src: If you are turning 65 or are newly eligible, your Initial Enrollment Period works differently from the annual window.
segments.tr: 65歳を迎える場合や新たに資格を得る場合、初期加入期間は年間ウィンドウとは異なります。

segments.src: Missing it can lead to late-enrollment penalties for some parts of Medicare, so look up your personal dates.
segments.tr: それを逃すと、メディケアの一部で加入遅延ペナルティにつながる可能性があるため、個人の日付を確認してください。

segments.src: ## Question 1: What Will This Plan Really Cost Me?
segments.tr: ## 質問1：このプランは実際にはいくらかかるのか？

segments.src: The monthly premium is the number people notice first, but it is only one piece of the cost.
segments.tr: 月額保険料は最初に気づく数字ですが、それはコストのほんの一部にすぎません。

segments.src: - **Premium:** The fixed monthly amount. For marketplace plans, this is the figure *after* any premium tax credit. Enter accurate income and household information on the application, since the credit depends on your expected income for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **保険料（プレミアム）：** 固定の月額金額。マーケットプレイスのプランの場合、これはプレミアム税額控除*後*の金額です。控除額は来年の予想所得に依存するため、申請書には正確な所得と世帯情報を入力してください。

segments.src: - **Deductible:** What you pay before the plan starts sharing costs for many services.
segments.tr: - **免責金額（デダクティブル）：** 多くのサービスに対してプランが費用の分担を開始する前に、あなたが支払う金額。

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance:** Flat fees or percentages you pay for visits, tests, procedures and prescriptions.
segments.tr: - **自己負担金（コペイおよびコインシュアランス）：** 診察、検査、手続き、および処方薬に対して支払う定額または割合。

segments.src: - **Out-of-pocket maximum:** The most you could pay in a year for covered, in-network care. After that, the plan pays covered costs.
segments.tr: - **年間自己負担上限額（アウト・オブ・ポケット・マキシマム）：** ネットワーク内の対象となるケアに対して、1年間に支払う可能性のある最大の金額。その後は、プランが対象費用を支払います。

segments.src: A plan with a low premium may carry a high deductible.
segments.tr: 保険料が低いプランには、高い免責金額が設定されている場合があります。

segments.src: A plan with a higher premium may cost less overall if you expect regular care.
segments.tr: 定期的なケアを予想している場合、保険料が高いプランのほうが全体的には安くなることがあります。

segments.src: A useful exercise is to estimate your likely year: how many doctor visits, specialist appointments, prescriptions and possible procedures you expect, and then add up what each plan would charge.
segments.tr: 有用な方法は、おそらく1年間にどれくらいの診察、専門医の予約、処方薬、そして起こり得る処置が必要になるかを見積もり、各プランがいくら請求するかを合計することです。

segments.src: ### A Note on Marketplace Subsidies
segments.tr: ### マーケットプレイスの補助金に関する注意

segments.src: The size of premium tax credits is set by federal law and has changed in recent years.
segments.tr: プレミアム税額控除の額は連邦法によって定められており、近年変更されています。

segments.src: Do not assume last year's price will repeat.
segments.tr: 昨年の価格がそのまま繰り返されると思い込んではいけません。

segments.src: Compare your actual 2027 quote, using the official marketplace's window-shopping tools or the Plan Finder, rather than relying on past experience.
segments.tr: 過去の経験に頼るのではなく、公式マーケットプレイスのウィンドウショッピングツールやプランファインダーを使用して、実際の2027年の見積もりを比較してください。

segments.src: Households that qualify for cost-sharing reductions should look closely at Silver-level plans, which can lower deductibles and copays for eligible enrollees.
segments.tr: 費用分担軽減の資格がある世帯は、資格を持つ加入者の免責金額や自己負担金を引き下げることができるシルバーレベルのプランを詳しく検討すべきです。

segments.src: ## Question 2: Are My Doctors and Hospitals In the Network?
segments.tr: ## 質問2：私のかかりつけ医や病院はネットワーク内にあるか？

segments.src: Networks are one of the most common reasons people regret a plan choice.
segments.tr: ネットワークは、人々がプランの選択を後悔する最も一般的な理由の1つです。

segments.src: - **Look up each doctor, specialist and hospital you use** in the plan's own provider directory, and confirm by phone with the office. Directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **利用するすべての医師、専門医、病院を**プラン独自のプロバイダーディレクトリで**調べ**、オフィスの電話で確認します。ディレクトリは古い場合があります。

segments.src: - **Understand the plan type.** HMO plans usually require you to use in-network providers and may require referrals. PPO plans generally offer more flexibility at higher cost. EPO plans typically do not cover out-of-network care except in emergencies.
segments.tr: - **プランのタイプを理解する。** HMOプランは通常、ネットワーク内のプロバイダーの利用を義務付けており、紹介状が必要な場合があります。PPOプランは一般的に、より高いコストでより多くの柔軟性を提供します。EPOプランは通常、緊急時を除き、ネットワーク外のケアをカバーしません。

segments.src: - **Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage:** Original Medicare is accepted by most doctors and hospitals nationwide that take Medicare. Medicare Advantage plans use networks and often include extras, but they may restrict you to a local area and may require prior authorization for some services.
segments.tr: - **オリジナル・メディケア対メディケア・アドバンテージ：** オリジナル・メディケアは、メディケアを受け入れる全国のほとんどの医師や病院で受け入れられています。メディケア・アドバンテージ・プランはネットワークを使用し、多くの場合特典が含まれていますが、地域が制限されたり、一部のサービスに事前承認が必要になったりする場合があります。

segments.src: - **Check where you travel or live part of the year.** If you spend months away, confirm what the plan covers outside its home area.
segments.tr: - **旅行先や1年のうち一部を過ごす場所を確認する。** 何ヶ月も離れた場所で過ごす場合、ホームエリア外でプランが何をカバーしているかを確認してください。

segments.src: ## Question 3: Does It Cover My Prescription Drugs?
segments.tr: ## 質問3：処方薬はカバーされるか？

segments.src: Drug coverage can change from year to year, even when you stay with the same plan.
segments.tr: 薬剤のカバーは、同じプランに留まる場合でも、年々変わる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Check the formulary** (the plan's list of covered drugs) for every medication you take, including the dose and form.
segments.tr: - **投与量や剤形を含め、服用するすべての薬についてフォーミュラリ**（プランのカバーされる医薬品リスト）**を確認する**。

segments.src: - **Look at the tier** each drug falls into, since higher tiers cost more.
segments.tr: - **各薬が属するティア（段階）を確認する。** 高いティアほど費用がかかるためです。

segments.src: - **Ask about restrictions** such as prior authorization, step therapy (trying a cheaper drug first) and quantity limits.
segments.tr: - **事前承認、ステップセラピー（より安価な薬を最初に試すこと）、および数量制限などの制限について尋ねる**。

segments.src: - **Confirm your pharmacy.** Some plans offer lower prices at preferred pharmacies.
segments.tr: - **薬局を確認する。** 一部のプランでは、推奨薬局でより低い価格を提供しています。

segments.src: - **Read your Annual Notice of Change.** Medicare plans send this document in the fall. It explains changes to costs, coverage and networks for next year, and it is easy to overlook.
segments.tr: - **年間変更通知を読む。** メディケアプランはこの書類を秋に送付します。来年のコスト、カバー、およびネットワークの変更について説明しており、見落としがちです。

segments.src: For Medicare Part D, an annual out-of-pocket cap on covered drug spending now exists, thanks to changes made by the Inflation Reduction Act.
segments.tr: メディケア・パートDに関しては、インフレ抑制法による変更のおかげで、カバーされる薬剤費用の年間自己負担上限額が現在存在します。

segments.src: The cap was $2,000 in 2025 and is adjusted for inflation in later years.
segments.tr: 上限額は2025年に2,000ドルであり、その後の年ではインフレに合わせて調整されます。

segments.src: Check the Medicare Plan Finder for the exact 2027 figure.
segments.tr: 正確な2027年の数値については、メディケア・プラン・ファインダーを確認してください。

segments.src: Many plans also offer the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which lets you spread out-of-pocket drug costs across the year in monthly installments instead of paying all at once.
segments.tr: 多くのプランでは、メディケア処方薬支払プランも提供されており、一度に全額を支払うのではなく、年間を通じて毎月の分割払いに自己負担の薬剤費を分散させることができます。

segments.src: Spreading the cost does not lower the total.
segments.tr: 費用を分散させても合計額は下がりません。

segments.src: ## Question 4: What Is the Worst-Case Scenario?
segments.tr: ## 質問4：最悪のシナリオは何か？

segments.src: Out-of-pocket caps are what protect you from a very expensive illness or accident.
segments.tr: 自己負担上限額は、非常に高額な病気や事故からあなたを守るものです。

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace plans** have a federal annual limit on out-of-pocket spending for in-network, covered essential health benefits. The limit is adjusted each year and is substantial for an individual, so look up the figure for the plan year you are choosing.
segments.tr: - **ACAマーケットプレイスのプラン**には、ネットワーク内のカバーされる必須健康ベネフィットに対する自己負担費用の連邦年間制限があります。制限は毎年調整され、個人にとってはかなりの額になるため、選択するプラン年の数値を調べてください。

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage plans** must include an annual limit on in-network out-of-pocket costs for Part A and Part B services. Limits differ by plan.
segments.tr: - **メディケア・アドバンテージ・プラン**には、パートAおよびパートBのサービスに対するネットワーク内の自己負担費用の年間制限を含める必要があります。制限はプランによって異なります。

segments.src: - **Original Medicare** has no annual out-of-pocket cap for Parts A and B. Many people add a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy or have other coverage, such as retiree or employer benefits, to help fill that gap. Medigap policies are sold separately, and your best time to buy one without medical underwriting is usually during your Medigap open enrollment period, so check the rules in your state.
segments.tr: - **オリジナル・メディケア**には、パートAおよびBの年間自己負担上限額がありません。多くの人は、そのギャップを埋めるために、メディギャップ（メディケア補足）ポリシーを追加するか、退職者や雇用主のベネフィットなどの他のカバーを持っています。メディギャップポリシーは別売りであり、医療的査読なしで購入するのに最適な時期は通常メディギャップのオープン・エンロールメント期間中であるため、お住まいの州のルールを確認してください。

segments.src: If you are weighing Original Medicare with Medigap against Medicare Advantage, think about predictability versus flexibility.
segments.tr: オリジナル・メディケアとメディギャップをメディケア・アドバンテージと比較している場合は、予測可能性と柔軟性について考えてみてください。

segments.src: Medigap typically means higher monthly premiums but fewer surprises and wide provider choice.
segments.tr: メディギャップは通常、毎月の保険料が高くなることを意味しますが、驚きが少なく、プロバイダーの選択肢が広がります。

segments.src: Advantage plans often have lower premiums and extra benefits but come with network rules and cost-sharing that varies by service.
segments.tr: アドバンテージ・プランは多くの場合、保険料が低く、追加のベネフィットがありますが、ネットワークのルールや、サービスによって異なる自己負担が伴います。

segments.src: ## Question 5: What Extra Benefits Do I Actually Use?
segments.tr: ## 質問5：実際にどの追加ベネフィットを利用するか？

segments.src: Plans, particularly Medicare Advantage plans, advertise dental, vision, hearing, gym memberships and over-the-counter allowances.
segments.tr: プラン、特にメディケア・アドバンテージ・プランは、歯科、視力、聴力、ジムのメンバーシップ、および市販薬の手当を宣伝しています。

segments.src: These can be valuable, but only if you use them.
segments.tr: これらは価値があるかもしれませんが、利用する場合に限ります。

segments.src: - Check the dollar limits and what is covered.
segments.tr: - 金額の制限と何がカバーされるかを確認する。

segments.src: - Look at whether your own dentist or eye doctor participates.
segments.tr: - 自分のかかりつけの歯科医や眼科医が参加しているかどうかを確認する。

segments.src: - Compare the value of these extras to any difference in premiums or cost-sharing.
segments.tr: - これらの特典の価値と、保険料や自己負担の差額を比較する。

segments.src: ## A Practical Step-by-Step Checklist
segments.tr: ## 実用的なステップバイステップのチェックリスト

segments.src: 1. **Mark your deadlines** on a calendar today, including the date by which you need to act for coverage to begin Jan. 1.
segments.tr: 1. 1月1日にカバーを開始するために行動する必要がある日付を含め、**締切をカレンダーに今日マークする**。

segments.src: 2. **Gather your information:** a list of doctors, medications with doses, preferred pharmacy, expected income (for marketplace subsidies) and your current plan documents.
segments.tr: 2. **情報を収集する：** 医師のリスト、投与量付きの薬、お気に入りの薬局、予想所得（マーケットプレイスの補助金用）、および現在のプランの書類。

segments.src: 3. **Read your current plan's notice of changes** before assuming it will stay the same.
segments.tr: 3. 同じままであると仮定する前に、**現在のプランの変更通知を読む**。

segments.src: 4. **Use official comparison tools:** Medicare.gov's Plan Finder for Medicare, and HealthCare.gov or your state exchange for marketplace plans.
segments.tr: 4. **公式の比較ツールを使用する：** メディケアの場合はMedicare.govのプラン・ファインダー、マーケットプレイスのプランの場合はHealthCare.govまたは州のエクスチェンジ。

segments.src: 5. **Compare total expected cost,** not just premium: premium plus likely out-of-pocket spending, with the out-of-pocket maximum as your worst case.
segments.tr: 5. 保険料だけでなく、**予想される総コストを比較する：** 保険料に、最悪のシナリオとしての自己負担上限額を持つ可能性のある自己負担支出を足したもの。

segments.src: 6. **Verify networks and formularies by phone,** not only online.
segments.tr: 6. オンラインだけでなく、**電話でネットワークとフォーミュラリを検証する**。

segments.src: 7. **Get free, unbiased help.** State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs) offer free counseling on Medicare. Marketplace navigators and certified application counselors can help with ACA enrollment at no charge.
segments.tr: 7. **無料で偏りのない助けを得る。** 州健康保険援助プログラム（SHIPs）は、メディケアに関する無料のカウンセリングを提供しています。マーケットプレイスのナビゲーターや認定申請カウンセラーは、無料でACAの加入を支援できます。

segments.src: 8. **Save confirmation** of your enrollment and watch for your first bill and insurance cards.
segments.tr: 8. **加入の確認を保存し**、最初の請求書と保険証に注意する。

segments.src: ## Beware of Common Pitfalls
segments.tr: ## 一般的な落とし穴に注意する

segments.src: - **Aggressive marketing.** Be cautious about unsolicited calls, mailers and ads. Legitimate Medicare plans cannot generally call you unprompted to sell a plan, and you should never share your Medicare number with someone you do not trust.
segments.tr: - **積極的なマーケティング。** 勧誘の電話、ダイレクトメール、広告には注意してください。正当なメディケアプランは通常、プランを販売するために予期せず電話をかけることはできず、信頼していない人にメディケア番号を決して共有してはなりません。

segments.src: - **Assuming auto-renewal is automatic savings.** Staying put is convenient, but premiums, networks and drug lists change. A quick review can reveal a better fit or catch a cost increase.
segments.tr: - **自動更新が自動的な節約であると思い込むこと。** そのままにしておくのは便利ですが、保険料、ネットワーク、薬剤リストは変更されます。簡単な見直しにより、より適したプランが見つかったり、コスト増をキャッチしたりできます。

segments.src: - **Reporting inaccurate income.** For marketplace plans, a big difference between estimated and actual income can result in repaying part of your credit at tax time.
segments.tr: - **不正確な所得の報告。** マーケットプレイスのプランでは、推定所得と実際の所得の大きな違いにより、税金の時期に控除の一部を返済することになる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites get busy near deadlines, and a missed window may leave you without coverage options until the next open enrollment unless you qualify for a special enrollment period due to a life event.
segments.tr: - **最後の日まで待つこと。** ウェブサイトは締切の近くで混雑し、逃した期間により、ライフイベントによる特別加入期間の資格がない限り、次のオープン・エンロールメントまでカバーの選択肢がない状態になる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Open enrollment is a limited-time chance to make sure your coverage matches your health needs and your budget.
segments.tr: オープン・エンロールメントは、あなたのカバーが健康上のニーズと予算に合致していることを確認するための期間限定のチャンスです。

segments.src: You do not need to be an insurance expert to do it well.
segments.tr: うまく行うために保険の専門家である必要はありません。

segments.src: Focus on five things: what you will really pay, whether your doctors are in the network, whether your drugs are covered, how much you could pay in a bad year, and which extras you will use.
segments.tr: 5つのことに焦点を当ててください：実際に支払う金額、医師がネットワークに入っているかどうか、薬がカバーされているかどうか、悪い年にいくら支払う可能性があるか、そしてどの特典を利用するか。

segments.src: Then confirm the facts with official sources and a free counselor, and make your decision before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: 次に、公式情報源と無料のカウンセラーで事実を確認し、締切が到来する前に決定を下してください。

segments.src: *Deadlines, benefit amounts and subsidy rules change.
segments.tr: *締切、給付額、および補助金のルールは変更されます。

segments.src: Verify current details at Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov or your state marketplace, and consult a licensed professional for advice about your situation.*
segments.tr: Medicare.gov、HealthCare.gov、または州のマーケットプレイスで現在の詳細を確認し、状況に関するアドバイスについてはライセンスを持つ専門家に相談してください。*

de.title: Öffnungszeit für die Anmeldung: Wie Sie ACA-Marktplatz- und Medicare-Tarife vor den Fristen vergleichen

segments.src: Every fall, millions of Americans face the same set of choices: keep the health plan they have, or switch.
segments.tr: Jeden Herbst stehen Millionen von Amerikanern vor denselben Entscheidungen: den aktuellen Krankenversicheritarif behalten oder wechseln.

segments.src: Medicare's annual enrollment period for most people runs from Oct.
segments.tr: Die jährliche Einschreibefrist von Medicare für die meisten Menschen läuft vom 15.

segments.src: 15 to Dec.
segments.tr: Okt. bis zum 7.

segments.src: 7, and most Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace deadlines fall in December or January.
segments.tr: Dez., und die meisten Fristen des Affordable Care Act (ACA)-Marktplatzes fallen in den Dezember oder Januar.

segments.src: With the clock running, a short list of questions can help you compare plans in a clear, orderly way.
segments.tr: Da die Zeit drängt, kann Ihnen eine kurze Liste von Fragen helfen, Tarife klar und geordnet zu vergleichen.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not personal insurance, tax or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient allgemeinen Informationen und stellt keine persönliche Versicherungs-, Steuer- oder Rechtsberatung dar.

segments.src: Rules, prices and deadlines vary by state and by plan, so confirm details with official sources before you decide.*
segments.tr: Regeln, Preise und Fristen variieren je nach Bundesstaat und Tarif, bestätigen Sie Details daher vor Ihrer Entscheidung mit offiziellen Quellen.*

segments.src: ## Know Which Calendar Applies to You
segments.tr: ## Finden Sie heraus, welcher Kalender für Sie gilt

segments.src: Start by identifying which system you belong to, because the dates differ.
segments.tr: Beginnen Sie damit, festzustellen, zu welchem System Sie gehören, da die Daten unterschiedlich sind.

segments.src: - **Medicare (Oct. 15 – Dec. 7):** During this window, people already in Medicare can switch between Original Medicare and a Medicare Advantage plan, change Advantage plans, or join, switch or drop a Part D prescription drug plan. Changes generally take effect Jan. 1.
segments.tr: - **Medicare (15. Okt. – 7. Dez.):** Während dieses Zeitfensters können Personen, die bereits bei Medicare sind, zwischen Original Medicare und einem Medicare Advantage-Tarif wechseln, Advantage-Tarife wechseln oder einem Part D-Verschreibungsarzneimitteltarif beitreten, diesen wechseln oder abwählen. Änderungen treten im Allgemeinen am 1. Jan. in Kraft.

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (Jan. 1 – March 31):** People already in a Medicare Advantage plan can make one change during this period, such as switching to another Advantage plan or returning to Original Medicare. It is not a second chance for everyone, so check whether it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (1. Jan. – 31. März):** Personen, die sich bereits in einem Medicare Advantage-Tarif befinden, können in diesem Zeitraum eine Änderung vornehmen, z. B. zu einem anderen Advantage-Tarif wechseln oder zu Original Medicare zurückkehren. Es ist keine zweite Chance für jeden, prüfen Sie also, ob es für Sie gilt.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace (varies by state):** On HealthCare.gov, the standard pattern has been to enroll by Dec. 15 for coverage starting Jan. 1, with open enrollment continuing into mid-January for coverage that starts later. Some state-run marketplaces set their own dates, and a few extend them. Check your state's exchange for its exact schedule.
segments.tr: - **ACA-Marktplatz (variiert je nach Bundesstaat):** Auf HealthCare.gov war das Standardmuster, sich bis zum 15. Dez. für einen Versicherungsschutz ab dem 1. Jan. anzumelden, wobei die offene Anmeldung bis Mitte Januar für einen später beginnenden Versicherungsschutz fortgesetzt wird. Einige staatlich geführte Marktplätze legen ihre eigenen Termine fest, und einige wenige verlängern sie. Überprüfen Sie die Börse Ihres Bundesstaates auf den genauen Zeitplan.

segments.src: - **Employer plans:** If you get coverage at work, your company sets its own enrollment window, often in the fall. This guide focuses on Medicare and marketplace plans.
segments.tr: - **Arbeitgebertarife:** Wenn Sie Ihren Versicherungsschutz am Arbeitsplatz erhalten, legt Ihr Unternehmen ein eigenes Anmeldefenster fest, oft im Herbst. Dieser Leitfaden konzentriert sich auf Medicare- und Marktplatztarife.

segments.src: If you are turning 65 or are newly eligible, your Initial Enrollment Period works differently from the annual window.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie 65 werden oder neu berechtigt sind, funktioniert Ihre Erstbezugsfrist anders als das jährliche Zeitfenster.

segments.src: Missing it can lead to late-enrollment penalties for some parts of Medicare, so look up your personal dates.
segments.tr: Das Verpassen dieser Frist kann für einige Teile von Medicare zu Strafen für verspätete Anmeldung führen, informieren Sie sich daher über Ihre persönlichen Termine.

segments.src: ## Question 1: What Will This Plan Really Cost Me?
segments.tr: ## Frage 1: Was wird mich dieser Tarif wirklich kosten?

segments.src: The monthly premium is the number people notice first, but it is only one piece of the cost.
segments.tr: Die monatliche Prämie ist der Betrag, den die Leute zuerst bemerken, aber sie ist nur ein Teil der Kosten.

segments.src: - **Premium:** The fixed monthly amount. For marketplace plans, this is the figure *after* any premium tax credit. Enter accurate income and household information on the application, since the credit depends on your expected income for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Prämie:** Der feste monatliche Betrag. Bei Marktplatztarifen ist dies der Betrag *nach* Abzug einer Beihilfesteuergutschrift. Geben Sie genaue Einkommens- und Haushaltsinformationen im Antrag an, da die Gutschrift von Ihrem voraussichtlichen Einkommen für das kommende Jahr abhängt.

segments.src: - **Deductible:** What you pay before the plan starts sharing costs for many services.
segments.tr: - **Selbstbehalt (Deductible):** Was Sie zahlen, bevor der Tarif für viele Leistungen die Kosten übernimmt.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance:** Flat fees or percentages you pay for visits, tests, procedures and prescriptions.
segments.tr: - **Zuzahlungen (Copays und Coinsurance):** Feste Gebühren oder Prozentsätze, die Sie für Besuche, Tests, Behandlungen und Verschreibungen zahlen.

segments.src: - **Out-of-pocket maximum:** The most you could pay in a year for covered, in-network care. After that, the plan pays covered costs.
segments.tr: - **Maximale Eigenbeteiligung (Out-of-pocket maximum):** Höchstbetrag, den Sie in einem Jahr für abgedeckte netzinterne Pflege zahlen müssen. Danach übernimmt der Tarif die gedeckten Kosten.

segments.src: A plan with a low premium may carry a high deductible.
segments.tr: Ein Tarif mit einer niedrigen Prämie kann einen hohen Selbstbehalt haben.

segments.src: A plan with a higher premium may cost less overall if you expect regular care.
segments.tr: Ein Tarif mit einer höheren Prämie kann insgesamt weniger kosten, wenn Sie regelmäßige Pflege erwarten.

segments.src: A useful exercise is to estimate your likely year: how many doctor visits, specialist appointments, prescriptions and possible procedures you expect, and then add up what each plan would charge.
segments.tr: Eine nützliche Übung besteht darin, Ihr voraussichtliches Jahr zu schätzen: wie viele Arztbesuche, Facharzttermine, Rezepte und mögliche Behandlungen Sie erwarten, und dann zu addieren, was jeder Tarif berechnen würde.

segments.src: ### A Note on Marketplace Subsidies
segments.tr: ### Ein Hinweis zu Marktplatz-Subventionen

segments.src: The size of premium tax credits is set by federal law and has changed in recent years.
segments.tr: Die Höhe der Prämiensteuergutschriften wird durch Bundesgesetz festgelegt und hat sich in den letzten Jahren geändert.

segments.src: Do not assume last year's price will repeat.
segments.tr: Gehen Sie nicht davon aus, dass sich der Preis des letzten Jahres wiederholt.

segments.src: Compare your actual 2027 quote, using the official marketplace's window-shopping tools or the Plan Finder, rather than relying on past experience.
segments.tr: Vergleichen Sie Ihr tatsächliches Angebot für 2027 mithilfe der Schaufenster-Shopping-Tools des offiziellen Marktplatzes oder des Plan Finders, anstatt sich auf vergangene Erfahrungen zu verlassen.

segments.src: Households that qualify for cost-sharing reductions should look closely at Silver-level plans, which can lower deductibles and copays for eligible enrollees.
segments.tr: Haushalte, die Anspruch auf Kostenbeteiligungsermäßigungen haben, sollten sich Tarife der Silberstufe genauer ansehen, die Selbstbehalte und Zuzahlungen für berechtigte Versicherte senken können.

segments.src: ## Question 2: Are My Doctors and Hospitals In the Network?
segments.tr: ## Frage 2: Sind meine Ärzte und Krankenhäuser im Netzwerk?

segments.src: Networks are one of the most common reasons people regret a plan choice.
segments.tr: Netzwerke sind einer der häufigsten Gründe, warum Menschen eine Tarifwahl bereuen.

segments.src: - **Look up each doctor, specialist and hospital you use** in the plan's own provider directory, and confirm by phone with the office. Directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **Suchen Sie jeden Arzt, Spezialisten und jedes Krankenhaus, das Sie nutzen**, im eigenen Anbieterverzeichnis des Tarifs und bestätigen Sie dies telefonisch mit dem Büro. Verzeichnisse können veraltet sein.

segments.src: - **Understand the plan type.** HMO plans usually require you to use in-network providers and may require referrals. PPO plans generally offer more flexibility at higher cost. EPO plans typically do not cover out-of-network care except in emergencies.
segments.tr: - **Verstehen Sie den Tariftyp.** HMO-Tarife verlangen in der Regel, dass Sie netzinterne Anbieter nutzen, und erfordern möglicherweise Überweisungen. PPO-Tarife bieten im Allgemeinen mehr Flexibilität zu höheren Kosten. EPO-Tarife decken netzferne Pflege in der Regel nur in Notfällen ab.

segments.src: - **Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage:** Original Medicare is accepted by most doctors and hospitals nationwide that take Medicare. Medicare Advantage plans use networks and often include extras, but they may restrict you to a local area and may require prior authorization for some services.
segments.tr: - **Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage:** Original Medicare wird von den meisten Ärzten und Krankenhäusern bundesweit akzeptiert, die Medicare annehmen. Medicare Advantage-Tarife nutzen Netzwerke und beinhalten oft Extras, können Sie jedoch auf ein lokales Gebiet beschränken und für einige Dienstleistungen eine vorherige Genehmigung erfordern.

segments.src: - **Check where you travel or live part of the year.** If you spend months away, confirm what the plan covers outside its home area.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie, wohin Sie reisen oder wo Sie einen Teil des Jahres leben.** Wenn Sie Monate entfernt verbringen, bestätigen Sie, was der Tarif außerhalb seines Heimatgebiets abdeckt.

segments.src: ## Question 3: Does It Cover My Prescription Drugs?
segments.tr: ## Frage 3: Deckt es meine verschreibungspflichtigen Medikamente ab?

segments.src: Drug coverage can change from year to year, even when you stay with the same plan.
segments.tr: Die Arzneimittelabdeckung kann sich von Jahr zu Jahr ändern, selbst wenn Sie beim selben Tarif bleiben.

segments.src: - **Check the formulary** (the plan's list of covered drugs) for every medication you take, including the dose and form.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie das Formularverzeichnis** (die Liste der abgedeckten Medikamente des Tarifs) für jedes Medikament, das Sie einnehmen, einschließlich Dosis und Darreichungsform.

segments.src: - **Look at the tier** each drug falls into, since higher tiers cost more.
segments.tr: - **Betrachten Sie die Stufe (Tier)**, in die jedes Medikament fällt, da höhere Stufen mehr kosten.

segments.src: - **Ask about restrictions** such as prior authorization, step therapy (trying a cheaper drug first) and quantity limits.
segments.tr: - **Fragen Sie nach Einschränkungen** wie Vorabgenehmigung, Stufentherapie (zuerst ein billigeres Medikament ausprobieren) und Mengenbegrenzungen.

segments.src: - **Confirm your pharmacy.** Some plans offer lower prices at preferred pharmacies.
segments.tr: - **Bestätigen Sie Ihre Apotheke.** Einige Tarife bieten niedrigere Preise in bevorzugten Apotheken.

segments.src: - **Read your Annual Notice of Change.** Medicare plans send this document in the fall. It explains changes to costs, coverage and networks for next year, and it is easy to overlook.
segments.tr: - **Lesen Sie Ihre jährliche Änderungmitteilung (Annual Notice of Change).** Medicare-Tarife senden dieses Dokument im Herbst. Es erklärt Änderungen bei Kosten, Deckung und Netzwerken für das nächste Jahr und wird leicht übersehen.

segments.src: For Medicare Part D, an annual out-of-pocket cap on covered drug spending now exists, thanks to changes made by the Inflation Reduction Act.
segments.tr: Für Medicare Part D gibt es dank Änderungen durch den Inflation Reduction Act nun eine jährliche Obergrenze für die Eigenbeteiligung an gedeckten Arzneimittelausgaben.

segments.src: The cap was $2,000 in 2025 and is adjusted for inflation in later years.
segments.tr: Die Obergrenze lag 2025 bei 2.000 USD und wird in den Folgejahren an die Inflation angepasst.

segments.src: Check the Medicare Plan Finder for the exact 2027 figure.
segments.tr: Überprüfen Sie den Medicare Plan Finder auf den genauen Wert für 2027.

segments.src: Many plans also offer the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which lets you spread out-of-pocket drug costs across the year in monthly installments instead of paying all at once.
segments.tr: Viele Tarife bieten auch den Medicare Prescription Payment Plan an, mit dem Sie die Arzneimittelkosten aus eigener Tasche über das Jahr in monatlichen Raten verteilen können, anstatt alles auf einmal zu bezahlen.

segments.src: Spreading the cost does not lower the total.
segments.tr: Die Verteilung der Kosten senkt nicht die Gesamtsumme.

segments.src: ## Question 4: What Is the Worst-Case Scenario?
segments.tr: ## Frage 4: Was ist das Worst-Case-Szenario?

segments.src: Out-of-pocket caps are what protect you from a very expensive illness or accident.
segments.tr: Eigenbeteiligungsobergrenzen schützen Sie vor einer sehr teuren Krankheit oder einem Unfall.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace plans** have a federal annual limit on out-of-pocket spending for in-network, covered essential health benefits. The limit is adjusted each year and is substantial for an individual, so look up the figure for the plan year you are choosing.
segments.tr: - **ACA-Marktplatztarife** haben eine bundesweite jährliche Obergrenze für Eigenbezugsausgaben für netzinterne, gedeckte wesentliche Gesundheitsleistungen. Die Obergrenze wird jedes Jahr angepasst und ist für eine Einzelperson erheblich, schlagen Sie daher den Betrag für das Tarifjahr nach, das Sie auswählen.

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage plans** must include an annual limit on in-network out-of-pocket costs for Part A and Part B services. Limits differ by plan.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Advantage-Tarife** müssen eine jährliche Obergrenze für netzinterne Eigenkosten für Dienstleistungen der Teile A und B enthalten. Die Obergrenzen variieren je nach Tarif.

segments.src: - **Original Medicare** has no annual out-of-pocket cap for Parts A and B. Many people add a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy or have other coverage, such as retiree or employer benefits, to help fill that gap. Medigap policies are sold separately, and your best time to buy one without medical underwriting is usually during your Medigap open enrollment period, so check the rules in your state.
segments.tr: - **Original Medicare** hat keine jährliche Obergrenze für die Eigenbeteiligung für Teile A und B. Viele Menschen fügen eine Medigap-Police (Medicare Supplement) hinzu oder haben andere Deckungen wie Rentner- oder Arbeitgeberleistungen, um diese Lücke zu füllen. Medigap-policen werden separat verkauft, und Ihre beste Zeit, eine ohne medizinische Zeichnung zu kaufen, ist in der Regel während Ihres Medigap-Anmeldezeitraums, prüfen Sie also die Regeln in Ihrem Bundesstaat.

segments.src: If you are weighing Original Medicare with Medigap against Medicare Advantage, think about predictability versus flexibility.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie Original Medicare mit Medigap gegen Medicare Advantage abwägen, denken Sie über Vorhersehbarkeit im Vergleich zu Flexibilität nach.

segments.src: Medigap typically means higher monthly premiums but fewer surprises and wide provider choice.
segments.tr: Medigap bedeutet in der Regel höhere monatliche Prämien, aber weniger Überraschungen und eine große Anbieterauswahl.

segments.src: Advantage plans often have lower premiums and extra benefits but come with network rules and cost-sharing that varies by service.
segments.tr: Advantage-Tarife haben oft niedrigere Prämien und zusätzliche Leistungen, gehen jedoch mit Netzwerkregeln und einer je nach Dienstleistung variierenden Kostenbeteiligung einher.

segments.src: ## Question 5: What Extra Benefits Do I Actually Use?
segments.tr: ## Frage 5: Welche Extras nutze ich tatsächlich?

segments.src: Plans, particularly Medicare Advantage plans, advertise dental, vision, hearing, gym memberships and over-the-counter allowances.
segments.tr: Tarife, insbesondere Medicare Advantage-Tarife, werben für Zahn-, Seh-, Hör-, Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaften und rezeptfreie Zuschüsse.

segments.src: These can be valuable, but only if you use them.
segments.tr: Diese können wertvoll sein, aber nur, wenn Sie sie nutzen.

segments.src: - Check the dollar limits and what is covered.
segments.tr: - Überprüfen Sie die Dollargrenzen und was abgedeckt ist.

segments.src: - Look at whether your own dentist or eye doctor participates.
segments.tr: - Schauen Sie, ob Ihr eigener Zahnarzt oder Augenarzt teilnimmt.

segments.src: - Compare the value of these extras to any difference in premiums or cost-sharing.
segments.tr: - Vergleichen Sie den Wert dieser Extras mit eventuellen Unterschieden bei Prämien oder Kostenbeteiligung.

segments.src: ## A Practical Step-by-Step Checklist
segments.tr: ## Eine praktische Schritt-für-Schritt-Checkliste

segments.src: 1. **Mark your deadlines** on a calendar today, including the date by which you need to act for coverage to begin Jan. 1.
segments.tr: 1. **Markieren Sie Ihre Fristen** noch heute in einem Kalender, einschließlich des Datums, bis zu dem Sie handeln müssen, damit der Schutz am 1. Jan. beginnt.

segments.src: 2. **Gather your information:** a list of doctors, medications with doses, preferred pharmacy, expected income (for marketplace subsidies) and your current plan documents.
segments.tr: 2. **Sammeln Sie Ihre Informationen:** eine Liste von Ärzten, Medikamente mit Dosierungen, bevorzugte Apotheke, erwartetes Einkommen (für Marktplatzsubventionen) und Ihre aktuellen Tarifdokumente.

segments.src: 3. **Read your current plan's notice of changes** before assuming it will stay the same.
segments.tr: 3. **Lesen Sie die Änderungsmitteilung Ihres aktuellen Tarifs**, bevor Sie davon ausgehen, dass er gleich bleibt.

segments.src: 4. **Use official comparison tools:** Medicare.gov's Plan Finder for Medicare, and HealthCare.gov or your state exchange for marketplace plans.
segments.tr: 4. **Nutzen Sie offizielle Vergleichstools:** den Plan Finder von Medicare.gov für Medicare und HealthCare.gov oder Ihre staatliche Börse für Marktplatztarife.

segments.src: 5. **Compare total expected cost,** not just premium: premium plus likely out-of-pocket spending, with the out-of-pocket maximum as your worst case.
segments.tr: 5. **Vergleichen Sie die erwarteten Gesamtkosten**, nicht nur die Prämie: Prämie plus wahrscheinliche Eigenbezugsausgaben, wobei das Eigenbeteiligungsmaximum Ihr Worst Case ist.

segments.src: 6. **Verify networks and formularies by phone,** not only online.
segments.tr: 6. **Überprüfen Sie Netzwerke und Formularverzeichnisse telefonisch**, nicht nur online.

segments.src: 7. **Get free, unbiased help.** State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs) offer free counseling on Medicare. Marketplace navigators and certified application counselors can help with ACA enrollment at no charge.
segments.tr: 7. **Holen Sie sich kostenlose, unvoreingenommene Hilfe.** State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs) bieten kostenlose Beratung zu Medicare. Marktplatz-Navigatoren und zertifizierte Antragsberater können kostenlos bei der ACA-Anmeldung helfen.

segments.src: 8. **Save confirmation** of your enrollment and watch for your first bill and insurance cards.
segments.tr: 8. **Speichern Sie die Bestätigung** Ihrer Anmeldung und achten Sie auf Ihre erste Rechnung und Versicherungskarten.

segments.src: ## Beware of Common Pitfalls
segments.tr: ## Vorsicht vor häufigen Fallstricken

segments.src: - **Aggressive marketing.** Be cautious about unsolicited calls, mailers and ads. Legitimate Medicare plans cannot generally call you unprompted to sell a plan, and you should never share your Medicare number with someone you do not trust.
segments.tr: - **Aggressives Marketing.** Seien Sie vorsichtig bei unerbetenen Anrufen, Werbesendungen und Anzeigen. Legitime Medicare-Tarife können Sie im Allgemeinen nicht unaufgefordert anrufen, um einen Tarif zu verkaufen, und Sie sollten Ihre Medicare-Nummer niemals an jemanden weitergeben, dem Sie nicht vertrauen.

segments.src: - **Assuming auto-renewal is automatic savings.** Staying put is convenient, but premiums, networks and drug lists change. A quick review can reveal a better fit or catch a cost increase.
segments.tr: - **Annahme, dass automatische Verlängerung automatische Ersparnis bedeutet.** Das Bleiben an Ort und Stelle ist bequem, aber Prämien, Netzwerke und Medikamentenlisten ändern sich. Eine kurze Überprüfung kann eine bessere Passform aufdecken oder eine Kostenerhöhung abfangen.

segments.src: - **Reporting inaccurate income.** For marketplace plans, a big difference between estimated and actual income can result in repaying part of your credit at tax time.
segments.tr: - **Angabe ungenauer Einkommen.** Bei Marktplatztarifen kann ein großer Unterschied zwischen geschätztem und tatsächlichem Einkommen dazu führen, dass Sie einen Teil Ihrer Gutschrift bei der Steuererklärung zurückzahlen müssen.

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites get busy near deadlines, and a missed window may leave you without coverage options until the next open enrollment unless you qualify for a special enrollment period due to a life event.
segments.tr: - **Warten bis zum letzten Tag.** Websites werden in der Nähe von Fristen voll, und ein verpasstes Zeitfenster kann Sie bis zur nächsten offenen Anmeldung ohne Versicherungsoptionen lassen, es sei denn, Sie haben Anspruch auf eine spezielle Anmeldefrist aufgrund eines Lebensereignisses.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: Open enrollment is a limited-time chance to make sure your coverage matches your health needs and your budget.
segments.tr: Die offene Anmeldung ist eine zeitlich begrenzte Chance, um sicherzustellen, dass Ihr Versicherungsschutz Ihren gesundheitlichen Bedürfnissen und Ihrem Budget entspricht.

segments.src: You do not need to be an insurance expert to do it well.
segments.tr: Sie müssen kein Versicherungsexperte sein, um es gut zu machen.

segments.src: Focus on five things: what you will really pay, whether your doctors are in the network, whether your drugs are covered, how much you could pay in a bad year, and which extras you will use.
segments.tr: Konzentrieren Sie sich auf fünf Dinge: was Sie wirklich bezahlen werden, ob Ihre Ärzte im Netzwerk sind, ob Ihre Medikamente abgedeckt sind, wie viel Sie in einem schlechten Jahr bezahlen könnten und welche Extras Sie nutzen werden.

segments.src: Then confirm the facts with official sources and a free counselor, and make your decision before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Bestätigen Sie dann die Fakten mit offiziellen Quellen und einem kostenlosen Berater und treffen Sie Ihre Entscheidung, bevor die Frist eintrifft.

segments.src: *Deadlines, benefit amounts and subsidy rules change.
segments.tr: *Fristen, Leistungsbeträge und Subventionsregeln ändern sich.

segments.src: Verify current details at Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov or your state marketplace, and consult a licensed professional for advice about your situation.*
segments.tr: Überprüfen Sie aktuelle Details auf Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov oder Ihrem staatlichen Marktplatz und konsultieren Sie einen lizenzierten Fachmann für Ratschläge zu Ihrer Situation.*

segments.src: ## Know Which Calendar Applies to You
segments.tr: ## Hiểu Rõ Lịch Nào Áp Dụng Cho Bạn

segments.src: Start by identifying which system you belong to, because the dates differ.
segments.tr: Bắt đầu bằng cách xác định bạn thuộc hệ thống nào, bởi vì các ngày là khác nhau.

segments.src: - **Medicare (Oct. 15 – Dec. 7):** During this window, people already in Medicare can switch between Original Medicare and a Medicare Advantage plan, change Advantage plans, or join, switch or drop a Part D prescription drug plan. Changes generally take effect Jan. 1.
segments.tr: - **Medicare (15 tháng 10 – 7 tháng 12):** Trong khoảng thời gian này, những người đã tham gia Medicare có thể chuyển đổi giữa Medicare Gốc và gói Medicare Advantage, thay đổi gói Advantage, hoặc tham gia, chuyển đổi hoặc hủy gói thuốc theo toa Phần D. Thay đổi thường có hiệu lực vào ngày 1 tháng 1.

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (Jan. 1 – March 31):** People already in a Medicare Advantage plan can make one change during this period, such as switching to another Advantage plan or returning to Original Medicare. It is not a second chance for everyone, so check whether it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Đăng Ký Mở Medicare Advantage (1 tháng 1 – 31 tháng 3):** Những người đã tham gia gói Medicare Advantage có thể thực hiện một thay đổi trong thời gian này, chẳng hạn như chuyển sang gói Advantage khác hoặc quay lại Medicare Gốc. Đây không phải là cơ hội thứ hai cho mọi người, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra xem nó có áp dụng cho bạn không.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace (varies by state):** On HealthCare.gov, the standard pattern has been to enroll by Dec. 15 for coverage starting Jan. 1, with open enrollment continuing into mid-January for coverage that starts later. Some state-run marketplaces set their own dates, and a few extend them. Check your state's exchange for its exact schedule.
segments.tr: - **Thị trường ACA (thay đổi theo tiểu bang):** Trên HealthCare.gov, mô hình tiêu chuẩn là đăng ký trước ngày 15 tháng 12 để có bảo hiểm bắt đầu từ ngày 1 tháng 1, với việc đăng ký mở tiếp tục đến giữa tháng 1 cho bảo hiểm bắt đầu sau đó. Một số thị trường do tiểu bang điều hành đặt ra ngày riêng của họ, và một số ít gia hạn chúng. Hãy kiểm tra sàn giao dịch của tiểu bang bạn để biết lịch trình chính xác của nó.

segments.src: - **Employer plans:** If you get coverage at work, your company sets its own enrollment window, often in the fall. This guide focuses on Medicare and marketplace plans.
segments.tr: - **Gói của chủ lao động:** Nếu bạn nhận bảo hiểm tại nơi làm việc, công ty của bạn sẽ đặt ra thời gian đăng ký riêng, thường là vào mùa thu. Hướng dẫn này tập trung vào các gói Medicare và thị trường.

segments.src: If you are turning 65 or are newly eligible, your Initial Enrollment Period works differently from the annual window.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn sắp bước sang tuổi 65 hoặc mới đủ điều kiện, Thời Gian Đăng Ký Ban Đầu của bạn hoạt động khác với khoảng thời gian hàng năm.

segments.src: Missing it can lead to late-enrollment penalties for some parts of Medicare, so look up your personal dates.
segments.tr: Bỏ lỡ nó có thể dẫn đến hình phạt đăng ký muộn cho một số phần của Medicare, vì vậy hãy tra cứu các ngày cá nhân của bạn.

segments.src: ## Question 1: What Will This Plan Really Cost Me?
segments.tr: ## Câu Hỏi 1: Gói Này Sẽ Thực Sự Tốn Bao Nhiêu Tiền Của Tôi?

segments.src: The monthly premium is the number people notice first, but it is only one piece of the cost.
segments.tr: Phí bảo hiểm hàng tháng là con số mọi người chú ý đầu tiên, nhưng đó chỉ là một phần của chi phí.

segments.src: - **Premium:** The fixed monthly amount. For marketplace plans, this is the figure *after* any premium tax credit. Enter accurate income and household information on the application, since the credit depends on your expected income for the coming year.
segments.tr: - **Phí bảo hiểm:** Số tiền cố định hàng tháng. Đối với các gói thị trường, đây là con số *sau* khi đã áp dụng bất kỳ khoản tín dụng thuế phí bảo hiểm nào. Nhập thông tin thu nhập và hộ gia đình chính xác vào đơn đăng ký, vì khoản tín dụng phụ thuộc vào thu nhập dự kiến của bạn cho năm tới.

segments.src: - **Deductible:** What you pay before the plan starts sharing costs for many services.
segments.tr: - **Khoản khấu trừ:** Số tiền bạn trả trước khi gói bắt đầu chia sẻ chi phí cho nhiều dịch vụ.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance:** Flat fees or percentages you pay for visits, tests, procedures and prescriptions.
segments.tr: - **Khoản đồng thanh toán và đồng bảo hiểm:** Phí cố định hoặc tỷ lệ phần trăm bạn trả cho các lần khám, xét nghiệm, thủ thuật và đơn thuốc.

segments.src: - **Out-of-pocket maximum:** The most you could pay in a year for covered, in-network care. After that, the plan pays covered costs.
segments.tr: - **Tối đa tự chi trả:** Số tiền nhiều nhất bạn có thể trả trong một năm cho việc chăm sóc trong mạng lưới được đài thọ. Sau đó, gói sẽ chi trả các chi phí được đài thọ.

segments.src: A plan with a low premium may carry a high deductible.
segments.tr: Một gói có phí bảo hiểm thấp có thể đi kèm với khoản khấu trừ cao.

segments.src: A plan with a higher premium may cost less overall if you expect regular care.
segments.tr: Một gói có phí bảo hiểm cao hơn có thể tốn ít hơn tính tổng thể nếu bạn mong đợi được chăm sóc thường xuyên.

segments.src: A useful exercise is to estimate your likely year: how many doctor visits, specialist appointments, prescriptions and possible procedures you expect, and then add up what each plan would charge.
segments.tr: Một bài tập hữu ích là ước tính năm có khả năng xảy ra của bạn: có bao nhiêu chuyến thăm bác sĩ, cuộc hẹn chuyên gia, đơn thuốc và các thủ thuật có thể xảy ra mà bạn mong đợi, sau đó cộng lại những gì mỗi gói sẽ tính phí.

segments.src: ### A Note on Marketplace Subsidies
segments.tr: ### Lưu Ý Về Các Khoản Trợ Cấp Thị Trường

segments.src: The size of premium tax credits is set by federal law and has changed in recent years.
segments.tr: Quy mô của các khoản tín dụng thuế phí bảo hiểm được ấn định bởi luật liên bang và đã thay đổi trong những năm gần đây.

segments.src: Do not assume last year's price will repeat.
segments.tr: Đừng cho rằng giá của năm ngoái sẽ lặp lại.

segments.src: Compare your actual 2027 quote, using the official marketplace's window-shopping tools or the Plan Finder, rather than relying on past experience.
segments.tr: So sánh báo giá thực tế năm 2027 của bạn, sử dụng các công cụ mua sắm cửa sổ của thị trường chính thức hoặc Trình Tìm Kiếm Gói, thay vì dựa vào kinh nghiệm trước đây.

segments.src: Households that qualify for cost-sharing reductions should look closely at Silver-level plans, which can lower deductibles and copays for eligible enrollees.
segments.tr: Các hộ gia đình đủ điều kiện nhận giảm chi phí chia sẻ nên xem xét kỹ các gói cấp độ Bạc, có thể làm giảm khoản khấu trừ và khoản đồng thanh toán cho những người đăng ký đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: ## Question 2: Are My Doctors and Hospitals In the Network?
segments.tr: ## Câu Hỏi 2: Các Bác Sĩ Và Bệnh Viện Của Tôi Có Nằm Trong Mạng Lưới Không?

segments.src: Networks are one of the most common reasons people regret a plan choice.
segments.tr: Mạng lưới là một trong những lý do phổ biến nhất khiến mọi người hối hận về việc lựa chọn gói.

segments.src: - **Look up each doctor, specialist and hospital you use** in the plan's own provider directory, and confirm by phone with the office. Directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **Tra cứu từng bác sĩ, chuyên gia và bệnh viện bạn sử dụng** trong thư mục nhà cung cấp của chính gói đó, và xác nhận qua điện thoại với văn phòng. Các thư mục có thể đã lỗi thời.

segments.src: - **Understand the plan type.** HMO plans usually require you to use in-network providers and may require referrals. PPO plans generally offer more flexibility at higher cost. EPO plans typically do not cover out-of-network care except in emergencies.
segments.tr: - **Hiểu loại gói.** Các gói HMO thường yêu cầu bạn sử dụng các nhà cung cấp trong mạng lưới và có thể yêu cầu giấy giới thiệu. Các gói PPO thường cung cấp sự linh hoạt hơn với chi phí cao hơn. Các gói EPO thường không đài thọ việc chăm sóc ngoài mạng lưới ngoại trừ trong các trường hợp khẩn cấp.

segments.src: - **Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage:** Original Medicare is accepted by most doctors and hospitals nationwide that take Medicare. Medicare Advantage plans use networks and often include extras, but they may restrict you to a local area and may require prior authorization for some services.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Gốc so với Medicare Advantage:** Medicare Gốc được chấp nhận bởi hầu hết các bác sĩ và bệnh viện trên toàn quốc chấp nhận Medicare. Các gói Medicare Advantage sử dụng mạng lưới và thường bao gồm các tiện ích bổ sung, nhưng chúng có thể hạn chế bạn ở một khu vực địa phương và có thể yêu cầu ủy quyền trước cho một số dịch vụ.

segments.src: - **Check where you travel or live part of the year.** If you spend months away, confirm what the plan covers outside its home area.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra nơi bạn đi lại hoặc sống một phần trong năm.** Nếu bạn dành nhiều tháng ở xa, hãy xác nhận những gì gói đài thọ bên ngoài khu vực quê nhà của nó.

segments.src: ## Question 3: Does It Cover My Prescription Drugs?
segments.tr: ## Câu Hỏi 3: Nó Có Đài Thọ Thuốc Theo Toa Của Tôi Không?

segments.src: Drug coverage can change from year to year, even when you stay with the same plan.
segments.tr: Phạm vi bảo hiểm thuốc có thể thay đổi từ năm này sang năm khác, ngay cả khi bạn giữ nguyên một gói.

segments.src: - **Check the formulary** (the plan's list of covered drugs) for every medication you take, including the dose and form.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra danh mục thuốc** (danh sách các loại thuốc được đài thọ của gói) cho mọi loại thuốc bạn dùng, bao gồm cả liều lượng và dạng.

segments.src: - **Look at the tier** each drug falls into, since higher tiers cost more.
segments.tr: - **Nhìn vào bậc** mà mỗi loại thuốc thuộc về, vì các bậc cao hơn có giá đắt hơn.

segments.src: - **Ask about restrictions** such as prior authorization, step therapy (trying a cheaper drug first) and quantity limits.
segments.tr: - **Hỏi về các hạn chế** như ủy quyền trước, liệu pháp theo bước (thử một loại thuốc rẻ hơn trước) và giới hạn số lượng.

segments.src: - **Confirm your pharmacy.** Some plans offer lower prices at preferred pharmacies.
segments.tr: - **Xác nhận nhà thuốc của bạn.** Một số gói cung cấp giá thấp hơn tại các nhà thuốc ưu đãi.

segments.src: - **Read your Annual Notice of Change.** Medicare plans send this document in the fall. It explains changes to costs, coverage and networks for next year, and it is easy to overlook.
segments.tr: - **Đọc Thông Báo Thay Đổi Hàng Năm của bạn.** Các gói Medicare gửi tài liệu này vào mùa thu. Nó giải thích những thay đổi về chi phí, phạm vi bảo hiểm và mạng lưới cho năm tới, và rất dễ bị bỏ sót.

segments.src: For Medicare Part D, an annual out-of-pocket cap on covered drug spending now exists, thanks to changes made by the Inflation Reduction Act.
segments.tr: Đối với Phần D của Medicare, giới hạn tự chi trả hàng năm đối với chi tiêu thuốc được đài thọ hiện đã tồn tại, nhờ các thay đổi do Đạo Luật Giảm Lạm Phát thực hiện.

segments.src: The cap was $2,000 in 2025 and is adjusted for inflation in later years.
segments.tr: Giới hạn là 2.000 đô la vào năm 2025 và được điều chỉnh theo lạm phát trong những năm sau đó.

segments.src: Check the Medicare Plan Finder for the exact 2027 figure.
segments.tr: Kiểm tra Trình Tìm Kiếm Gói Medicare để biết con số chính xác năm 2027.

segments.src: Many plans also offer the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which lets you spread out-of-pocket drug costs across the year in monthly installments instead of paying all at once.
segments.tr: Nhiều gói cũng cung cấp Chương Trình Thanh Toán Thuốc Theo Toa Medicare, cho phép bạn trải đều chi phí thuốc tự chi trả trong suốt cả năm thành các đợt trả góp hàng tháng thay vì trả tất cả một lần.

segments.src: Spreading the cost does not lower the total.
segments.tr: Việc trải đều chi phí không làm giảm tổng số tiền.

segments.src: ## Question 4: What Is the Worst-Case Scenario?
segments.tr: ## Câu Hỏi 4: Kịch Bản Xấu Nhất Là Gì?

segments.src: Out-of-pocket caps are what protect you from a very expensive illness or accident.
segments.tr: Giới hạn tự chi trả là những gì bảo vệ bạn khỏi một căn bệnh hoặc tai nạn rất đắt đỏ.

segments.src: - **ACA marketplace plans** have a federal annual limit on out-of-pocket spending for in-network, covered essential health benefits. The limit is adjusted each year and is substantial for an individual, so look up the figure for the plan year you are choosing.
segments.tr: - **Các gói thị trường ACA** có giới hạn hàng năm của liên bang đối với chi tiêu tự chi trả cho các phúc lợi y tế thiết yếu được đài thọ trong mạng lưới. Giới hạn được điều chỉnh mỗi năm và đáng kể đối với một cá nhân, vì vậy hãy tra cứu con số cho năm gói bạn đang chọn.

segments.src: - **Medicare Advantage plans** must include an annual limit on in-network out-of-pocket costs for Part A and Part B services. Limits differ by plan.
segments.tr: - **Các gói Medicare Advantage** phải bao gồm giới hạn hàng năm đối với chi phí tự chi trả trong mạng lưới cho các dịch vụ Phần A và Phần B. Giới hạn khác nhau tùy theo gói.

segments.src: - **Original Medicare** has no annual out-of-pocket cap for Parts A and B. Many people add a Medigap (Medicare Supplement) policy or have other coverage, such as retiree or employer benefits, to help fill that gap. Medigap policies are sold separately, and your best time to buy one without medical underwriting is usually during your Medigap open enrollment period, so check the rules in your state.
segments.tr: - **Medicare Gốc** không có giới hạn tự chi trả hàng năm cho Phần A và Phần B. Nhiều người thêm chính sách Medigap (Bổ Sung Medicare) hoặc có các bảo hiểm khác, chẳng hạn như phúc lợi cho người về hưu hoặc chủ lao động, để giúp lấp đầy khoảng trống đó. Các chính sách Medigap được bán riêng, và thời điểm tốt nhất để mua một chính sách mà không cần bảo lãnh y tế thường là trong thời gian đăng ký mở Medigap của bạn, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra các quy tắc ở tiểu bang của bạn.

segments.src: If you are weighing Original Medicare with Medigap against Medicare Advantage, think about predictability versus flexibility.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn đang cân nhắc Medicare Gốc với Medigap so với Medicare Advantage, hãy suy nghĩ về tính dự đoán so với tính linh hoạt.

segments.src: Medigap typically means higher monthly premiums but fewer surprises and wide provider choice.
segments.tr: Medigap thường có nghĩa là phí bảo hiểm hàng tháng cao hơn nhưng ít bất ngờ hơn và có nhiều lựa chọn nhà cung cấp rộng rãi.

segments.src: Advantage plans often have lower premiums and extra benefits but come with network rules and cost-sharing that varies by service.
segments.tr: Các gói Advantage thường có phí bảo hiểm thấp hơn và các phúc lợi bổ sung nhưng đi kèm với các quy tắc mạng lưới và việc chia sẻ chi phí thay đổi theo dịch vụ.

segments.src: ## Question 5: What Extra Benefits Do I Actually Use?
segments.tr: ## Câu Hỏi 5: Những Phúc Lợi Bổ Sung Nào Tôi Thực Sự Sử Dụng?

segments.src: Plans, particularly Medicare Advantage plans, advertise dental, vision, hearing, gym memberships and over-the-counter allowances.
segments.tr: Các gói, đặc biệt là các gói Medicare Advantage, quảng cáo các khoản trợ cấp nha khoa, thị lực, thính giác, thành viên phòng tập thể dục và thuốc không kê đơn.

segments.src: These can be valuable, but only if you use them.
segments.tr: Những điều này có thể có giá trị, nhưng chỉ khi bạn sử dụng chúng.

segments.src: - Check the dollar limits and what is covered.
segments.tr: - Kiểm tra giới hạn đô la và những gì được đài thọ.

segments.src: - Look at whether your own dentist or eye doctor participates.
segments.tr: - Xem xét nha sĩ hoặc bác sĩ mắt của chính bạn có tham gia không.

segments.src: - Compare the value of these extras to any difference in premiums or cost-sharing.
segments.tr: - So sánh giá trị của những tiện ích bổ sung này với bất kỳ sự khác biệt nào về phí bảo hiểm hoặc chia sẻ chi phí.

segments.src: ## A Practical Step-by-Step Checklist
segments.tr: ## Danh Sách Kiểm Tra Từng Bước Thực Tế

segments.src: 1. **Mark your deadlines** on a calendar today, including the date by which you need to act for coverage to begin Jan. 1.
segments.tr: 1. **Đánh dấu thời hạn của bạn** trên lịch ngay hôm nay, bao gồm cả ngày mà bạn cần hành động để bảo hiểm bắt đầu vào ngày 1 tháng 1.

segments.src: 2. **Gather your information:** a list of doctors, medications with doses, preferred pharmacy, expected income (for marketplace subsidies) and your current plan documents.
segments.tr: 2. **Thu thập thông tin của bạn:** danh sách bác sĩ, thuốc kèm liều lượng, nhà thuốc ưa thích, thu nhập dự kiến (cho các khoản trợ cấp thị trường) và tài liệu gói hiện tại của bạn.

segments.src: 3. **Read your current plan's notice of changes** before assuming it will stay the same.
segments.tr: 3. **Đọc thông báo thay đổi của gói hiện tại của bạn** trước khi giả định nó sẽ giữ nguyên.

segments.src: 4. **Use official comparison tools:** Medicare.gov's Plan Finder for Medicare, and HealthCare.gov or your state exchange for marketplace plans.
segments.tr: 4. **Sử dụng các công cụ so sánh chính thức:** Trình Tìm Kiếm Gói của Medicare.gov cho Medicare, và HealthCare.gov hoặc sàn giao dịch tiểu bang của bạn cho các gói thị trường.

segments.src: 5. **Compare total expected cost,** not just premium: premium plus likely out-of-pocket spending, with the out-of-pocket maximum as your worst case.
segments.tr: 5. **So sánh tổng chi phí dự kiến,** không chỉ phí bảo hiểm: phí bảo hiểm cộng với chi tiêu tự chi trả có khả năng xảy ra, với mức tối đa tự chi trả là tình huống xấu nhất của bạn.

segments.src: 6. **Verify networks and formularies by phone,** not only online.
segments.tr: 6. **Xác minh mạng lưới và danh mục thuốc qua điện thoại,** không chỉ trực tuyến.

segments.src: 7. **Get free, unbiased help.** State Health Insurance Assistance Programs (SHIPs) offer free counseling on Medicare. Marketplace navigators and certified application counselors can help with ACA enrollment at no charge.
segments.tr: 7. **Nhận trợ giúp miễn phí, không thiên vị.** Chương Trận Hỗ Trợ Bảo Hiểm Y Tế Tiểu Bang (SHIPs) cung cấp tư vấn miễn phí về Medicare. Những người định hướng thị trường và tư vấn viên ứng dụng được chứng nhận có thể giúp đăng ký ACA mà không mất phí.

segments.src: 8. **Save confirmation** of your enrollment and watch for your first bill and insurance cards.
segments.tr: 8. **Lưu xác nhận** đăng ký của bạn và chú ý đến hóa đơn đầu tiên và thẻ bảo hiểm của bạn.

segments.src: ## Beware of Common Pitfalls
segments.tr: ## Cẩn Thận Với Các Cạm Bẫy Phổ Biến

segments.src: - **Aggressive marketing.** Be cautious about unsolicited calls, mailers and ads. Legitimate Medicare plans cannot generally call you unprompted to sell a plan, and you should never share your Medicare number with someone you do not trust.
segments.tr: - **Tiếp thị hung hăng.** Hãy thận trọng với các cuộc gọi, thư gửi và quảng cáo không mời mà đến. Các gói Medicare hợp pháp thường không thể gọi cho bạn mà không được nhắc trước để bán một gói, và bạn không bao giờ nên chia sẻ số Medicare của mình với người mà bạn không tin tưởng.

segments.src: - **Assuming auto-renewal is automatic savings.** Staying put is convenient, but premiums, networks and drug lists change. A quick review can reveal a better fit or catch a cost increase.
segments.tr: - **Giả định gia hạn tự động là tiết kiệm tự động.** Việc ở lại một chỗ rất thuận tiện, nhưng phí bảo hiểm, mạng lưới và danh sách thuốc thay đổi. Một đánh giá nhanh có thể tiết lộ sự phù hợp hơn hoặc bắt kịp sự gia tăng chi phí.

segments.src: - **Reporting inaccurate income.** For marketplace plans, a big difference between estimated and actual income can result in repaying part of your credit at tax time.
segments.tr: - **Báo cáo thu nhập không chính xác.** Đối với các gói thị trường, sự khác biệt lớn giữa thu nhập ước tính và thu nhập thực tế có thể dẫn đến việc phải trả lại một phần tín dụng của bạn vào thời điểm thuế.

segments.src: - **Waiting until the last day.** Websites get busy near deadlines, and a missed window may leave you without coverage options until the next open enrollment unless you qualify for a special enrollment period due to a life event.
segments.tr: - **Đợi đến ngày cuối cùng.** Các trang web trở nên bận rộn gần thời hạn, và một khoảng thời gian bị lỡ có thể khiến bạn không có lựa chọn bảo hiểm nào cho đến đợt đăng ký mở tiếp theo trừ khi bạn đủ điều kiện tham gia thời gian đăng ký đặc biệt do một sự kiện cuộc sống.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm Mấu Chốt

segments.src: Open enrollment is a limited-time chance to make sure your coverage matches your health needs and your budget.
segments.tr: Đăng ký mở là cơ hội có thời hạn để đảm bảo bảo hiểm của bạn khớp với nhu cầu sức khỏe và ngân sách của bạn.

segments.src: You do not need to be an insurance expert to do it well.
segments.tr: Bạn không cần phải là một chuyên gia bảo hiểm để làm điều đó tốt.

segments.src: Focus on five things: what you will really pay, whether your doctors are in the network, whether your drugs are covered, how much you could pay in a bad year, and which extras you will use.
segments.tr: Tập trung vào năm điều: những gì bạn sẽ thực sự trả, liệu các bác sĩ của bạn có trong mạng lưới hay không, liệu thuốc của bạn có được đài thọ hay không, bạn có thể phải trả bao nhiêu trong một năm tồi tệ, và những tiện ích bổ sung nào bạn sẽ sử dụng.

segments.src: Then confirm the facts with official sources and a free counselor, and make your decision before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Sau đó, xác nhận các sự thật với các nguồn chính thức và một cố vấn miễn phí, và đưa ra quyết định của bạn trước khi thời hạn đến.

segments.src: *Deadlines, benefit amounts and subsidy rules change.
segments.tr: *Thời hạn, số tiền phúc lợi và quy tắc trợ cấp thay đổi.

segments.src: Verify current details at Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov or your state marketplace, and consult a licensed professional for advice about your situation.*
segments.tr: Xác minh các chi tiết hiện tại tại Medicare.gov, HealthCare.gov hoặc thị trường tiểu bang của bạn, và tham khảo ý kiến của một chuyên gia được cấp phép để được tư vấn về tình huống của bạn.*
